name: Mega Man Legacy Collection
summary: Mega Man Legacy Collection is a celebration of the 8-bit history of Capcom’s iconic Blue Bomber featuring faithful reproductions of the series’ origins with the original six Mega Man games.

name: Realm of Taiwu
summary: Realm of Taiwu is a The Scroll of Taiwu spin-off. The story unfolds across an alternate branching timeline of the original universe: the Taiwu Hero never arrives, the Fuyu Sword falls to Xiangshu, and the world sinks into endless darkness.

name: Multiplayer Military
summary: Multiplayer Military - Aliens are invading the Military Base. The World needs Your Help. You and Your team of Elite Soldiers must take out ALL Aliens and Save the Planet.

name: DEATH PENALTY
summary: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

name: Heroes' Vow: Three Kingdoms
summary: This Three Kingdoms sandbox RPG lets you do whatever you wish in the late Han Dynasty. Be a ruler, courtier, or hermit. Make friends, marry, raise children, manage estates, train yourself & allies, govern, drill troops, experience & alter history, and conquer all to win the hearts of the people.

name: Shotgun Witch
summary: Only armed with a double barrel shotgun, go through waves of hell spawns to get your book back! A bullet hell arena shooter!

name: Bunny Hill
summary: Carve the slopes of the Bunny Hill on your skis in this fast paced physics racing game. With up to 8 player Online Multiplayer, dodge bushes and tag flags on randomly generated maps to reach infinite scaling speed with your friends.

name: Rapid Raccoons
summary: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, and grabbing crates by hand or lasso to keep your load aboard. Upgrade your raft, find items and cosmetics, all while trying to meet a quota that continuously gets larger and larger.

name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

name: The Last Spell
summary: Defend the last bastion of humanity with your squad of heroes! Exterminate fiendish monsters with magic and brute force by night and re-build your battered city defenses by day in this tactical RPG with rogue-lite mechanics.

name: Metropolis Gear: Tactical City-Building Action
summary: Build your fully destructible, tile-based city and defend it using giant robots in this turn-based, tactical roguelike. Modify your weapons with endlessly stacking upgrades, but be careful! Your weapons could be a bigger threat to the city than your enemies!

name: Missile Command Delta
summary: Missiles are incoming. The stakes are high. Only you can stop the destruction. Manage your pool of defenses strategically to survive rounds of incoming missiles in this high-pressure, tactical turn-based game. Will you be able to unravel the mystery in time?

name: Jungle Rumble
summary: Become a fearless soldier, face off against the evil Skull and his army in the heart of the Amazon jungle. Survive deadly traps, ambushes, and explosive battles to restore peace. Will you emerge victorious?

name: Violent Horror Stories 2
creators: Trioskaz / thesecondleft / Garage Heathen / Alex Grim / INDIEPUNK / Bober Bros / myceliumforest / UniOwl / CapyDev / Anifan Gelati
summary: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.

name: Trash Horror Collection
summary: Welcome to a true 80's trash horror experience. This collection has 10 short horror games that you can freely choose which one you want to play.

name: Once,in Times of Chaos
summary: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

name: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
summary: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

name: The Mercenary Rise
summary: It tells the story of Stephen Gray, who inherited his father's legacy and managed the Mercenary Corps of Thunder Anger.

name: Settlement Zero
summary: Settlement Zero is a first-person VR adventure using free movement, mixing open exploration with frantic combat as you defend yourself against autonomous spacecraft and robots.

name: Shotgun Legend
summary: Eugene must battle aliens and the undead in search of a truck rim, as it seems to be his ticket home.

name: Driver® Parallel Lines
summary: You were the fastest wheelman on the street. You were a legend. You were money. Until they set you up and sent you down. Twenty-eight years inside for someone else's crime. Now you're getting out. Guess what? You got a new job, it's called getting revenge.

name: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective
summary: Become a forensic specialist in a realistic crime lab simulator. Investigate crime scenes, collect microscopic evidence, and identify perpetrators in the lab using DNA and digital analysis. Based on the experience and insights of experts from the State Criminal Police Office Rhineland-Palatinate.

name: Silent Hill Homecoming
summary: In Silent Hill Homecoming, Alex Shepherd has returned to his hometown of Shepherd's Glen to investigate the sudden disappearance of his brother. From Shepherd's Glen to the foggy streets of Silent Hill, Alex will face the darkest of horrors while struggling with his own grip on reality.

name: Ghost on the Shore
summary: An exploration game about emotional ties that transcend even death. Riley is faced with a headstrong ghost, urging her on an adventure across atmospheric shores, uncovering the island's tragic secret. Choices in dialogue shape the bond between the two, ultimately deciding Riley's fate.

name: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
summary: Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

name: Virtual City Playground®: Build Your Metropolis
summary: Relaxing city builder where you grow a vibrant metropolis, produce goods, manage transit and build iconic landmarks at your own pace.

name: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 1
summary: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series is back! Vol. 1 contains Mega Man Battle Network 1-3, including both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 3 for a total of four titles, plus additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! In addition, online play is supported!

name: Drifting Lands
summary: Drifting Lands is an hybrid of classical horizontal shoot'em'up with a lot of strong gameplay elements coming straight from the action-RPG genre. If you want an original diablo-like game or you want a different kind of shoot'em'up, you're in the right place!

name: Mercenary Kings: Reloaded Edition
summary: Craft your arsenal to avenge your fallen comrades and save the world from the fearsome forces of CLAW!

name: Relic Arena
summary: Relic Arena is an 8-player free-to-play autobattler. Equip heroes with relics and build game-breaking combos, led by legendary historical figures.

name: The Drifting Woods
summary: Join Amelia Dair apprentice witch extraordinaire, as she discovers her powers, unravels the mysteries of Sigil Island and learns about her family’s dark past.

name: Tales of Cosmos
summary: Tales of Cosmos is an old-school point-and-click adventure game set in a huge open world planetary system. Pilot your rocket across space, land on planets and moons, solve puzzles, and unravel a cosmic mystery with the help of a genius monkey and a wondrous talking dog.

name: Dream Flash
summary: Sharpen your mind and soul with hundreds of items in an infinite fast paced bullet hell rogue-lite dreamscape. Explore endless dream synergies and transform into even stronger altered states in order to combat dozens of increasingly difficult bosses.

name: Summer Room8
summary: After coming home from work, you find that your own room has become completely unfamiliar... This is a short adult-oriented anomaly-spotting game inspired by The Exit 8. Your goal is to spot anomalies and escape from a mysterious space. When you're feeling tired, let Maria, who's sitting on the sofa, help you relax.

name: Burden Street Station
summary: A surreal, narrative adventure game where you shapeshift during conversations to uncover how God went missing.

name: Hyper Knights
summary: Slash and Dash, raise your army, learn powerful combos and take back your land!

name: The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and The Detective Servant
summary: Living as a servant to the Kaiju Princess in a colorful cohabitation lifestyle! An enriching and exciting time management love development game.

name: The Relic: First Guardian
summary: A dark action RPG rooted in Korean mythology, with brutal, fast combat.

name: Drifting in Space
summary: Drifting in Space is an action Rogue-lite for those with a love for difficult games. Inspired by the uncertainty of space itself along with all the movies, literature and games that accompany it. Enjoy crossing this dark and dangerous rendition of the cosmos.

name: North Shore
summary: North Shore is a top down skating exploration game in which the player navigates a series of connected waterways. To do so, the player must learn to master the art of skating to effectively navigate through these spaces. As they progress they encounter scenes of natural beauty and danger.

name: Service with a Shotgun
summary: Service With a Shotgun [SWAS] is a mash up of visual novel storytelling and chaotic wave game shooting. You're the last poor soul manning a beat-up roadside shop in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Shoot straight. Talk fast. Surely nothing can go wrong. Right?

name: SHORE
summary: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

name: Hentai Military
summary: Hentai Military is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of military and 24 unique sexy girls. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

name: Siege Hammer
summary: Siege Hammer is an entry-level VR game created for the entire family to enjoy. Uniquely-designed for comfort, it delivers hours of fun-filled playtime. Are you the hammer…. Or the anvil?

name: Drift On Destiny Line
summary: Drift on Destiny Line is a game where racing and school life collide. Follow a young man from small-town roots as he steps into the collage and dark underground racing world. Meet seven girls different personalities. Build relationships and make choices that shape your destiny. Win or lose!

name: Super Gloves Hero
summary: Can you save the Shubby planet from the most dangerous pirate spaceship?

name: Inertial Drift
summary: An arcade racer that tears up the rule book with innovative twin-stick controls, completely re-imagined driving mechanics and a huge roster of fiercely individual cars and tracks.

name: Stacks:Jungle!
summary: Stacks:Jungle is an engaging adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more!

name: Mega Man Legacy Collection 2
summary: The Blue Bomber is back in this second collection of classic Capcom titles! Featuring faithful reproductions of Mega Man 7, 8, 9, & 10, this collection is bursting with additional content, from time trials and remix challenges to a music player and an extensive gallery of rare illustrations.

name: Swamp Up
summary: Jump between mushrooms, collect power-ups and break records while exploring your own path through a procedurally generated map in this fun yet challenging Precision Platformer with Roguelite elements. Be fast, precise, and skillful to avoid all of its dangers. And remember, never touch the water.

name: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus
summary: Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries.

name: Farming Camp
summary: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

name: Death at Fleming Manor
summary: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

name: Good Job - Prologue
summary: Take charge of a business that no one could put on their resume. Manage the girls at the underground massage parlor, delight customers with herbal blends, expand your e-commerce business, and grow your empire without drawing too much attention!

name: Unsorted Horror
summary: A collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery and dread.

name: Going Medieval
summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

name: The Monstrous Horror Show
summary: Four girls find their way into an abandoned hospital, each for her own reasons. Will they manage to unravel the dark secrets hiding within, escape safely, and return to their normal, peaceful lives?

name: CURE - A Hospital Simulator
summary: Manage the night shift of an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: Diagnose patients. Design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. If you're a creator, connect the game to Twitch and make the audience your patients for even more fun!

name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
summary: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

name: Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise
summary: As a maid in the elegance of a vampire household, use clues from your dreams to earn the love of your masters.

name: Death Howl
summary: Master the grid, defy death. Enter a grim Spirit Realm in this open-world deck builder. Craft lethal decks from 160+ cards, claim powerful Totems, and defeat foes in tactical grid combat. Fight as the desperate hunter Ro to bring her son back from beyond the veil.

name: Nova Drift
summary: Nova Drift distills the mechanical depth and strategy of an ARPG into classic arcade space combat. Control an endlessly evolving bio-mechanical ship, face legions of strange and deadly foes, and ride the wake of a dying star across the void.

name: Monkey Gang
summary: Monkey Gang is an autobattler based on teamwork, where you can create a team of monkeys for fighting waves of enemies! Create strategies, unlock new monkeys, buy upgrades and make unique teams to reach the furthest you can!

name: Drifting Ark
summary: A compact indie mech-defense game with AAA-inspired visual ambition. Build defensive lines, pilot your mech on the ground and in the air, unleash Overdrive, and call in bomber support. Between battles, enjoy a small shipboard area with light dialogue.

name: The Mosquito Gang
summary: The ultimate party game! In The Mosquito Gang, team up to battle mutant mosquito swarms in co-op PvE or fight in chaotic asymmetric PvP. Outrageous weapons, wild powers, and nonstop laughter—bring the party to life!

name: Mercenary Skirmish
summary: Multiplayer action fantasy based medieval RPG with deep character development. Be a Warrior, Archer, Mage or a Priest. Each hero has different skill-sets and character customization/development. Beat the arena to be the Master!

name: Black Geyser: Couriers of Darkness
summary: Black Geyser is an isometric, party-based fantasy RPG inspired by genre classics. Recruit characters with unique personalities and explore a land ravaged by civil war and a mysterious curse of greed. Your choices, good or evil, will decide the fate of the Kingdom of Isilmerald.

name: WORLD OF HORROR
summary: Experience the quiet terror of this 1-bit love letter to Junji Ito and H.P. Lovecraft. Navigate a hellish roguelite reality with turn-based combat and unforgiving choices. Experiment with your deck of event cards to discover new forms of cosmic horror in every playthrough. The inevitable awaits...

name: Midwest 90: Rapid City
summary: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a tycoon survival sim in a monster apocalypse. Run a roadhouse serving monster meat and choose between profit or the city's survival, because those who fight monsters risk becoming one. How far will you go to stay in business?

name: Lacey's Flash Games
summary: These are the REAL girls’ games. Charlie (Charchar887) discovers Lacey's mid-2000s Flash games and their disturbing secrets. Enter the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the website's missing creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey and her friends!

name: Missile Dancer 2
summary: Missile Dancer 2 is a new sprite scaler shmup that combines rail shooter and caravan STG.

name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
creators: Ubisoft Singapore / Ubisoft Barcelona / Ubisoft Bordeaux / Ubisoft Belgrade / Ubisoft Chengdu / Ubisoft India / Ubisoft Kyiv / Ubisoft Montpellier / Ubisoft Philippines / Ubisoft Quebec / Ubisoft Shanghai / Ubisoft Montreal / Ubisoft Romania
summary: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

name: Summer Memories
summary: It's summer break, and it's been years since you've last seen your aunt and cousins in the countryside! You don't know what to expect, but what could go wrong? Find out in Summer Memories!

name: 100 Ruin Cats
summary: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

name: Nether Abyss
summary: Scale the doomed Nether Abyss to leap into the Well of Reincarnation. In this dark Chinese Action-Roguelite with Extraction mechanics, rise as a nameless undead from the blood pools. Scavenge the fallen, endure cycles of rebirth, slay ancient demons, and draw your blade against heaven as you climb.

name: Maiden and Spell
summary: Maiden & Spell is a magical girl battle game, set in a cutesy fantasy world. Select from one of eight young ladies to battle 1 on 1 with a friend, or fight your way through a series of bosses and learn the secrets of The Kingdom of Stars.

name: CONCLUSE 2 - The Drifting Prefecture
summary: Concluse 2 is an atmospheric horror game which takes place immediately after the events of Concluse. Face off with the denizens of the Edison Hotel and the expansive Drifting Prefecture.

name: The Bow: Ultimate weapon
summary: A top-down shooter incremental game where you defeat enemies, sell loot, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat bosses for special items, and shape your own combat build through steady progression.

name: FLASH AND DIE
summary: You've been hired by a real estate agency to photograph their listings at night, giving them a unique look online. Grab your camera, explore dark, quiet homes, and capture every required shot before the property notices you. Uncover the truth: why do these listings need to be photographed at night?

name: My Summer Car
summary: My Summer Car is the ultimate car owning, building, fixing, tuning, maintenance AND permadeath life survival simulator. You start the game with hundreds of loose parts and assemble both car and engine.

name: Croquettes Gang
summary: Keep an eye on your master, steal his kibble and achieve your dream!

name: Lowpoly Drifting
summary: Lowpoly drift games use simplified graphics for a distinct look. Players control a car and aim to drift through turns for points and the best score, requiring skillful driving to balance speed and control.

name: Swamp Fellas
summary: Swamp Fellas is a cozy multiplayer game up to 8 players where frogs fish, vibe, and cause mild chaos. Explore a chill island, talk with friends via proximity chat with a reactive character, and mess around with weird props in a third space made for silly fun moments.

name: Red Bow
summary: If you were given another chance, would you take it? Or leave it in the hands of a little girl? Play as Roh, a young girl stuck in a bizarre nightmare of dark and eerie creatures.

name: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship
summary: Hailed by reviewers and professional drivers, the standard-setting off-road racing simulation has been reinvented! Reach the 2021 season podium, and to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the competition, relive the highlights at the wheel of legendary cars.

name: Dumpster Gang
summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

name: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin
summary: Blast, slice and shred through your enemies in this hardcore FPS inspired by the icons of the '90s, powered by the legendary Quake-1 Tech. Taking place in a realm left to rot, take up arms, unearth long-forgotten secrets and hunt down the Guardians of the Old World.

name: CarX Rally
summary: A realistic rally simulator powered by its own physics engine. Adapt your driving style to different cars, surfaces, and weather conditions, tackle hundreds of special stages created by the community in the in-game level editor, and compete against drivers from around the world.

name: House 2
summary: As a terrible storm rages on, a young girl tries to survive in a HOUSE hell-bent on killing her and her family...

name: Nancy Drew®: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon
summary: Catch this train — it’s your ticket to solving a century-old mystery!

name: MECCHA HORROR
summary: Two games in one! Descend into a co-op horror survival roguelite. PAINT, RUN, and HIDE to SURVIVE! Grow STRONGER with unique upgrades every run! █A█R█G█ Relax and paint your way through a colorful roguelite, or battle your “friends” in PvP to prove WHO is the ULTIMATE ARTIST!

name: Thank You Bus Driver
summary: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.

name: Fuck This Job
summary: Play as Jake, a janitor threatened to be replaced by AI machines, then subsequently fired.Grab your super vacuum cleaner, use it to hoover and destroy everything in your path in this AI-infected company! Shoot and kick everything that is in your path to show your capabilities as a great employee.

name: TrackMania² Canyon
summary: TrackMania² Canyon will let you experience the fun and adrenaline of racing stunning cars on sensational tracks in a major enhanced sequel to Nadeo Studio’s online racing phenomenon TrackMania, already enjoyed by millions of players.

name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
summary: Embark on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure where you attempt to re-establish a haven for the lost dwarven civilization. Journey across varied lands, help those in need, gather resources and fight off goblins and monsters as you slowly rebuild a home for your people.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
summary: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge reunites Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael as they kick shell in a beautifully realized beat ’em up.

name: Shotgun Chicken
summary: Shotgun chicken is a Foddian Precision Platformer Where you use your trusty old shotgun to make it back to the chicken coop but just one wrong move can send you tumbling down to the bottom.

name: Nidgets: Award Winning Idle Simulator
summary: A screensaver with a body count. No progression, no ending, and it has won no awards. Spawn Nidgets, grab lightsabers, and walk away while they slaughter each other.

name: False Hero
summary: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

name: Summer Blue
summary: The sea around this island used to glow — until one year the light stopped coming. You arrive for a summer work-stay and meet four girls. Clean rooms, mix drinks, head out to sea. Four full routes, hand-drawn animation, and a whole island waiting for you to light it up again.

name: Relic Space
summary: Experience deeply simulated, hex-based space combat as an elite starship pilot. Explore a ruined solar system, upgrade your ship, and lead your faction to greatness in this tactical, space RPG with 4X elements.

name: Swing Swamp
summary: Swing, swing, keep swinging! Move as freely as spider! Shoot, shoot, keep shooting! Smash all those annoying flies!

name: Sins of a Solar Empire II
summary: Battle for galactic dominance in this real-time 4X strategy game with unrivaled scale! You’ll explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate through military force, diplomacy, trade, culture, influence, and other underhanded tactics.

name: Speed Stars
summary: Simple but challenging rhythm-based running game. Compete to achieve the highest rank, unlock more characters, set personal bests, and climb the leaderboards.

name: Mystical Demon Farm
summary: Mystical Demon Farm is a cute, cozy, but lively farm game that blends farming simulation, monster collecting, and dungeon crawling. Collect Demons, grow your operation, and build an amazing farm worthy of the Queen’s recognition!

name: Mega Man X Legacy Collection
summary: Mega Man X Legacy Collection includes the legendary 16-bit titles and the series’ exciting foray into the 32-bit era: Mega Man X, Mega Man X2, Mega Man X3, and Mega Man X4. Test your skills in the new X Challenge mode, which pits players against two deadly bosses at once.

name: Artemis Cosmos
summary: Cosmos simulates a spaceship bridge of up to six players, guarding your deep space stations against the menacing Kraliens and Torgoth. Immerse yourself in a modern space game with enhanced graphics and endless customization possibilities, guaranteeing countless hours of exhilarating fun.

name: Job Joust
summary: Dunk and bump your friends in this 6-Players physics party game with wacky characters. Become a levitating Doctor or an exploding policeman with cumulative perks and show your friends what’s the best job!

name: Demon Bluff
summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

name: Hardpack Rally
summary: Vern, a retired rally driver, leaves you an old two-door and a note on the hood. Slide through woodland bends, mountain passes, snowy hills and open desert. Beat Vern’s stage times and earn the next set of keys as you progress through a single-player arcade rally career.

name: My Demon Family
summary: 🔞 My Demon Family 🔞is a FULLY ANIMATED, hand-drawn adult visual novel set in a hidden city of supernatural beings. You play as a horny young demon living with your seductive MILF MOTHER and two tempting SISTERS. Breed all the girls in town, INCLUDING your own family members. 🤰

name: Within the Cosmos
summary: Within the Cosmos is a sci-fi RPG. After awakening in a secluded star system, you soon discover a fractured human society grappling with an emerging android threat. Explore planets, uncover mysteries, and navigate differing philosophies. Your choices will shape how the story unfolds.

name: Bomb U!
summary: Bomb U! is a VR PvP action game. You have to look and walk around as in reality to pick up items, use them to destroy enemy's ground and win the game. We got bombs, hammers and pistols in the game. More items and modes adding!

name: Missile Input
summary: An action-packed typing game where you shoot down UFOs, jets, birds and more from your missile base. Unlock special equipment and take part in a dynamic storyline influenced by your targeting choices.

name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
summary: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open! This is a short but twisty detective case.

name: Summer Vacation
summary: Summer Vacation is a gay adult visual novel about self-discovery, first love, and the chaos... of figuring out who you really are. Join Mat through this summer, and his first year at university. Every choice shapes the bonds you build, and the person you'll become.

name: Swim Meet
summary: There's nothing better than swimming with a variety of women. Work hard and play hard with these beautiful swimmers to ensure the best of endings together as you compete for a place on the team.

name: Hammer Kid
summary: A charming pixel art platform adventure, reminiscent of the good old 16-bit days. Served as the foundation for the retro-platformer Tiny Thor.

name: Mega Monster Metropolis
summary: Level up your monsters, give them cool items and powerful abilities to create killer combos, then use them to defeat your opponent! MEGA MONSTER METROPOLIS is all about strategy and making your monsters the strongest in the city!

name: My Lovable Demon
summary: You summoned a hot demon girl: Go on dates❤️ || Grow your relationship🌱 || Pat her head🫳 || Battle evil⚔️ || and F**K a lot! 🔞

name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
summary: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

name: Truxton Extreme
summary: Take down hordes of alien invaders with your Power Shot, Truxton Beam, Thunder Laser, Homing Shot, Star‑mine Shot, and more! Don't forget to breathe as you face off against gigantic bosses in the ultimate battle for humanity’s survival!

name: Re: Award
summary: Corridor walking simulator. You can walk in the corridor. Rin and Scarlett came to Rin's grandfather's house in the country.

name: Army of Ruin
summary: Wreak havoc on countless foes with mighty weapons and deadly spells! Enhance your skills and face even greater dangers! Army of Ruin is an auto-shooter where you become the Bullet Hell.

name: One Military Camp
summary: Build your own military camp, manage the economy, recruit the best candidates and train them to become elite specialists. Send them on missions across the land to end the war once and for all!

name: Back in the Swamp
summary: A first-person point-and-click exploration adventure set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic swamp filled with giant insects and abandoned robots. Observe your surroundings, find the right objects, and progress through the ruins in this 3–4 hour atmospheric journey.

name: Ashley Clark: Secret of the Ruby
summary: Detective Ashley Clark is puzzled by a series of mysterious kidnappings. The only connection between these unusual disappearances is a ruby pendant. Could someone be using this sparkling ornament to send a clandestine message, or could this be the handiwork of an underground cult?

name: A Viking's Quest, the Lost Continent
summary: Inspired by the breath and depth of classic RPG and farming games,"A Viking's Quest, the Lost Continent" is an engaging, dynamic world role playing game where you experience a beautifully hand crafted world of fantasy and adventure.

name: Crash Puzzle Hammer-San
summary: A full-fledged action puzzle game with simple controls. Enjoy a massive volume of content with 300 stages and a stage editor that lets you create your own levels freely. Share your edited stages with other users via the Steam Workshop.

name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
summary: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Raise grand armies and wield devastating spells to overcome your foes in both solo and multiplayer.

name: House Party
summary: House Party is an edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s. Every decision changes your story and every character has something to reveal. There’s also a button to take your pants off.

name: Sakura Swim Club
summary: In Sakura Swim Club, follow the story of Kaede, just your average guy. Upon transferring to a new school, he meets two beautiful girls in the swim club. Things haven't gone well for the swim club lately, but with Kaede's help, that all changes.

summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

summary: Experience the Game Boy-like design and 2D open world of this retro JRPG. The choices you make are all up to you, and they may end up providing invaluable help in the future, when disaster strikes... Embark on an adventure in which you sew the threads of your own future.

Flesh-hungry tentacles, mafian zombies, and the occasional missing sock are no match for The Darkside Detective.

Whether it's your work at the office or a relationship you've carefully nurtured, each choice determines how this story unfolds—and perhaps the direction of your career!

name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
summary: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

name: The Shore
summary: THE SHORE is a first person story driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations, You will encounter mysterious creatures and unravel the secrets behind them. Strong elements of horror, struggle to survive an unknown world that will make you question your own sanity.

name: TROPHY FLEET

name: Brick Building
summary: It´s ideal for collaborative works with students and teachers of universities and colleges, because it’s disruptive and transversal tool for many subjects.

name: Tunnel Escape
summary: Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters and unspeakable dangers!

name: Silly Polly Beast
summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

name: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
summary: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

name: Solar Ash
summary: From the creators of the award-winning Hyper Light Drifter comes the high-speed and gravity-bending world of Solar Ash.

name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
creators: Wild Shadow Studios / Deca Live Operations GmbH
summary: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

name: Commander Quest
summary: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

name: Relic Abyss
summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with 💪might, 🪄magic, and 🎡lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...🦑🌎

name: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
summary: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an intense, action-movie inspired single player shooter created for VR and Non-VR. As a professional hitman, take on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld - one contract at a time.

name: Supply Chain Idle
summary: Build, link and upgrade factories to produce and sell products.

name: Under a Rock
summary: A procedural open-world survival craft game for 1-10 players. Explore a primitive but dangerous place with a different evolutionary path; here, wildlife is oversized, Neanderthals still exist, and curses are real.

name: Blood Strike
summary: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between.

name: The Cave
summary: Assemble your team of three from seven unlikely adventurers, then descend into the mysterious depths to explore The Cave!

name: FIND ALL 3: Travel
summary: Look for hidden cats, raccoons, other animals and objects, color this painted world. You have to go on an exciting journey through different levels. More than 1500 items of varying difficulty are waiting for you!

name: Space Rock Breaker
summary: Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

name: Red Stone Online
summary: Red Stone is an online 2.5D Ultimate Transformation MMORPG! The story of Red Stone begins in the fantasy world of Prandel as players go on an adventurous quest to search for a mystical red stone that fell from the Celestial World.

name: Anime Armpits
summary: Anime Armpits... It can't get better than this...

name: TUNNEL DIVERS
summary: Dive, destroy and escape. TUNNEL DIVERS is a F2P high octane twin stick shooter, where you pilot a close quarters based spaceship that excels in claustrophobic areas. Play online with or against other pilots, create your own levels in the level editor, and wage war against the rogue AI, Watch Dog.

name: WolfQuest: Anniversary Edition
summary: Live the life of a wild wolf in a realistic ecological simulation set in Yellowstone National Park.

name: Silver Pines
summary: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

name: Crownways: A Settlement Economy
summary: Build your own medieval settlement! Establish production chains, manage resources, and connect buildings through a network of roads and flags. Carriers move goods throughout your economy as you expand your territory and develop new regions in a single-player strategy simulation.

name: HELLDIVERS™ Dive Harder Edition
summary: HELLDIVERS™ is a hardcore, cooperative, twin stick shooter. As part of the elite unit called the HELLDIVERS, players must work together to protect SUPER EARTH and defeat the enemies of mankind in an intense intergalactic war.

name: Fright Train
summary: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

name: Keep Crafting
summary: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

name: Hop Step Sing! Kimamani☆Summer vacation (HQ Edition)
summary: Take a trip to the beach with the members of Hop Step Sing! In the 3rd song from our VR idol group, the viewer can be a part of the story; the conclusion all depends on who you were watching... Are you ready to join your three singing and dancing companions on their carefree summer vacation?

name: Ninja and the Quest for the Jade Statue
summary: Silently race through the town on your quest to collect every piece of the jade statue in this single-button platform-hell rage-game .

name: Eggstreme Farming
summary: Build and manage your own farm! Take care of chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys, collect and sell eggs, buy new animals, expand your pens, and turn your farm into a thriving egg-production empire.

name: Anomaly Company
summary: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

name: Bugs in Boots
summary: Explore a vast, mysterious, interconnected world made entirely of clay. Meet strange critters, collect forbidden fruit and uncover the mysteries of this place as you journey to see "The Moon" for the first time.

name: Minecraft Dungeons
summary: Fight your way through an exciting action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

name: F-117A Nighthawk Stealth Fighter 2.0
summary: Down below, the enemy sits unaware while a sleek, metallic creature slices through the dark. No blips show on the radar, no sign is given. Then, an instant, the roar of exploding ordnance shatters the night, demolishing targets, sending troops and pilots scrambling.

name: Sand to Soil
summary: Turn this desert planet into a lush green habitat! Find seeds, manage water, and improve the soil levels. Sadly, you were sent on this mission with woefully insufficient equipment, so you will have to harness the most potent resource on the planet: a flowery species of sheep, and their poop.

name: Heart Beat Clue
summary: "Heart Beat Clue" merges detective puzzles with romantic storylines. Players' choices affect both mysteries and relationships, offering a unique, interactive experience where love and investigation intersect.

name: Keyboard Maestro  Voyage
summary: "Keyboard Maestro Voyage" is a music game using a MIDI keyboard, simulating real performances. Play in sync with flowing notes in this classic-style game. Start quickly by simply choosing a song and sheet music.

name: NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS
summary: Legendary ninjas reunite in the next exciting entry of the STORM series! NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS is an action/fighting game with fast-paced ninja battles and two different story modes.

name: Amatarasu Riddle Star
summary: Daily life meets fantastical fairy tales in this slice-of-life romance Visual Novel. Pursue one of five unique and quirky heroines in this funny, charming tale of wishes, dreams, and love.

name: FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Maiden of Black Water
summary: “FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Maiden of Black Water” comes to Steam for the first time to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the horror-adventure series FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO. The game is set on sacred Mt. Hikami, a site of many mysterious and terrifying incidents.

name: Robot Detour
summary: А fun and innovative puzzle game about a wired robot who delivers batteries to his wireless friends.

name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

name: Clay Clinic
summary: A chaotic co-op medical job sim for up to 6 players. Treat clay patients, run risky procedures, fix your friends’ mistakes, and survive each hospital shift without causing too much malpractice.

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2026
summary: Lead your club to greatness in Pro Basketball Manager 2026! The Basketball Champions League arrives with 53 licensed teams, putting you in charge of every decision as you aim to dominate both domestic and continental basketball.

name: Stream Avatars
summary: Stream Avatars is a content creation tool for live video broadcasting that adds flair to your video to promote viewer engagement and channel growth! Viewers can also spend their hard-earned stream currency on avatar customizations.

name: Wolf Territory
summary: Wolf Territory is a survival adventure game. It's the story of Kyle and his friends who lost their way in the forest.

name: War Wind
summary: War Wind is a real-time strategy game that allows you to view an epic battle through the eyes of four unique races, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. The game features 28 ready-to-play scenarios and a story of such compelling depth you won't believe it's just a game.

name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
summary: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!

name: s&box
summary: s&box is a game creation platform. Play, create, and share games, all in one place. Hundreds of games ready to jump into with your friends.

name: iRacing
summary: We are the world’s premier motorsports racing game. An iRacing membership provides entry into the newest form of motorsport: internet racing. Internet racing is a fun, easy, and inexpensive way for race fan and gamers alike to enjoy the thrill of the racetrack from the comfort of their home.
