summary: MIST SURVIVAL is a Single-player, survival stealth sandbox game Players will experience the Apocalypse stimulation in the form of virus pandemic, the players have to deal with it to survive through the difficulties such as finding shelter and food, threats from the environment and climate: wild animals, bandits, infected, and dense mist t

name: Oaken Tower
summary: Oaken Tower is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

name: Rusty Lake Paradise
summary: Rusty Lake Paradise is set on a small remote island which is cursed by the ten plagues of Egypt. Solve all the mysteries of this dark, macabre puzzle adventure. Paradise builds upon the distinctive atmosphere and excitement from the Rusty Lake series.

name: Skull Stompers
summary: Have you noticed how everyone acts like whoever is most offended, wins? Society bends over backward for fragile feelings—but not here. Introducing the most offensive game ever—where nobody cares about your feelings. Shove ‘em up your ASS!

name: Glider Sim Deluxe – Soaring Simulator
summary: Soar through 3 custom maps or explore the entire globe with Google Earth integration. Pilot hang gliders, paragliders, paramotors, mini-wings, speed-wings, ultralight trikes, or racing drones. Customize weather conditions and fly solo or with friends. Perfect for seasoned pilots and newcomers alike!

name: Quick Quick Serve!
summary: Turn a four-table diner into a bustling idle restaurant! Serve dishes, hire waiters, and upgrade your kitchen as every coin brings the next upgrade closer. A relaxed incremental game with patient customers and a satisfying journey from hands-on serving to automatic earnings.

name: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
summary: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends. Supports up to 16 players in online co-op.

name: Pistol Wizard
summary: Play as a wizard with otherworldly tech and up to four friends hidden as mushroom people in this game of hide-and-seek where every move could give you away. As the clock counts down, will you blend in or take your stand against the wizard?

name: Out of the Park Baseball 27
summary: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! You are firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise - today or at any point in history! Your team, your way, your rules.

name: Night Shift Hospital
summary: A chaotic co-op job sim for up to 4 players about night-shift doctors. Handle a bizarre stream of patients, diagnose illnesses, and assign people to the correct treatment zones. Work as a team, get through nightly crises, and try your best not to get fired!

name: Summer Pockets
summary: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.

name: Water You Doing?
summary: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

name: Sister Travel
summary: It has begun! The story of an adventurer and his sister-like companions. Brought to you by Kagura Games and Inusuku. Sister Travel is here!

name: Devil Spire Falls
summary: The open-world action-RPG, where you can do anything, of your dreams… as if it came out 30 years ago!

name: Tower! Simulator 3
summary: The Gold Standard in Air Traffic Control Simulation Control aircraft at 11 included airports, issue voice commands, manage traffic, and work together in multiplayer in the most immersive air traffic control simulator available.

name: House Flipper 2
summary: Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

name: Bang Average Football – Play, Manage, Create
summary: Celebrate the beautiful game in Bang Average Football, a fast-paced, easy-to-learn arcade football game for 1-4 players. Play with friends in co-op and PvP multiplayer, turn an underdog team into champions as player-manager in Story mode, or design your own teams, leagues, and tournaments.

name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
summary: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

name: Assault Android Cactus+
summary: Assault Android Cactus is an intense arcade style twin stick shooter - pick from one of nine unique synthetic heroines and blast your way through overwhelming robots hordes to save the ship from its own workforce. Supports single player and local co-op game modes.

name: Rose Riddle 2: Werewolf Shadow
summary: A menacing presence has claimed its first victim on the streets of the Fairy Kingdom! More will follow unless you solve the mystery of the Werewolf Shadow!

name: Shadow Dungeon
summary: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the Shadow Dungeon, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

name: Mud and Blood
summary: Mud and Blood, the cult classic flash real time strategy game, returns with its signature take on infantry tactics. Command a small squad through brutal battles against unfair odds. This is combat. Experience the chaos and unceremonious violence of modern war, where every decision counts.

name: Drift86
summary: Get in your favorite car and set records alone or with friends in this unique arcade game!

name: Waifu Discovered 3: Cyberpunk Fantasy
summary: From the creators of Waifu Discovered 2, an arcade anime shoot’em up with a unique strip’em up twist where the better you play, the more you reveal. Battle enemies, defeat absurd bosses and unlock stunning waifus piece by piece.

name: Breaking Clay
summary: A goofy shooter with satisfying destruction: smash the clay world to pieces and fend off crazy cartoon creatures!

name: Station to Station
summary: ‘Station to Station’ is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

name: Lust Goddess
summary: Lust Goddess is a hot and thrilling collectible card game, in which you will assemble your unique squad of sexy mercenary girls. Earn their love and trust, and they will show you their gratitude by bringing your wildest and lewdest fantasies to life!

name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
summary: Get ready for the ultimate kart racing experience on Steam & Steam Deck! Inspired by Crash Team Racing, built with its own identity, advanced gameplay systems, tons of new features and massive modding support for endless replayability!

name: Pistol Dancer
summary: Twos hands two guns! Shoot'em up style rhythmic FPS. Press the trigger alongside music beats to unleash devastating power to the enemies Your enemies are little virus bits trying to reach the heart, and you are the last line of defence!

name: Figure Workshop
summary: 《Figure Workshop> is a virtual Figure maker,which generate by MMD model and motion.It can customize materials and expressions of figures, and there are also several interesting scenes for photography.

name: Anime Artist
summary: Anime Artist is a casual-puzzle game that will allow you to Sketch, Color and Collect anime artworks. Are you ready? This is your best chance to become the ultimate Anime Artist.

name: Jack Axe
summary: Be Jack! Get an axe! Take Jack (and her sisters) on an axe tossing, single or multiplayer, platforming adventure in a vibrant open world inspired by Filipino and Norse mythology.

name: World Climate Lab
summary: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

name: Volcano Eruption
summary: A short and sweet VR experience of seeing a underwater volcano scene turn to an island chain. No moving required just sit back and enjoy the show.

name: Pistol Whip
summary: Enter: the ultimate action hero. Pistol Whip is a physical action-rhythm game where film-inspired gunplay and blood-pumping beats collide. Blast, duck and dodge your way through fever dream Scenes, build unique rhythms in a ballet of bullets and claim glory on the leaderboards. Includes mod support!

name: About Fishing
summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

name: Building Destruction
summary: Multiplayer sandbox with destructible environment. Destroy different maps, build your own, and play with your friends and other people online

name: Soaring Machinariae
summary: A girls' adventure story, told through a traditional action RPG! Control Iris the Machinariae to explore fields and dungeons, and fight against monsters with sword combos, items, and special moves!

name: Extreme Exorcism
summary: Extreme Exorcism is a paranormal platformer where every move you make comes back to haunt you.

name: Emerald Caravan
creators: Space Fox Games / Jujubee S.A. / Salient Games
summary: Set in a vibrant and mystical world, Emerald Caravan will invite you to embark on a journey filled with magic, mystery, and discovery. Travel, explore dungeons, sell goods in your caravan shop and discover the secrets of your family's business!

name: Life Makeover
summary: Explore Life Makeover: Unleash your style, dye outfits, and design freely. Dive into unlimited dress-up, build your dream home - all for free.

name: Life of a Mercenary
summary: Lead a mercenary company seeking fame and fortune. Be honorable and help defend the kingdom or take contracts to those who pay the most. Rise to the top of the mercenary chain in this medieval story based around the events of The Great Tournament.

name: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline
summary: Mega Man X DiVE reimagined the world of the Mega Man X series, and now it's getting an offline version! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of "what-if" worlds in Mega Man X!

name: Glide BTL
summary: Racing begins where the roads end! In GlideBTL you're in for thrilling aerial battles, risky maneuvers, and full immersion in a cyberpunk atmosphere. Create your perfect glide and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate pilot!

name: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
summary: Staffer Case is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders. Each mystery unraveled leads you closer to the truth lying at the heart of each case!

name: Juice Galaxy
summary: Juice Galaxy is a happy place to fly around and smack things and drink juice. And explore things. And just, flip around doing stuff.

name: Character House -Desktop Companion-
summary: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
summary: Build your elite team in Duelist: Idle Expedition, the idle auto-battler that lives on your taskbar. Recruit from a pool of 90+ JRPG pixel-art roles and lead your traveling camp to victory against all the powerful Guilds on the Continent. Your epic journey continues even when you are busy!

name: Stellar Blade™
summary: Save humanity from extinction in post-apocalyptic action-adventure Stellar Blade™. Experience blistering combat and a twisting storyline as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall.

name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
summary: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
summary: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

name: Phantom Blade Zero
summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

name: High On Life 2
summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

name: Absolute Drift
summary: Absolute Drift is a racing game about becoming a master at the art of drifting.

name: Walkabout Mini Golf VR
summary: Escape into a fun and beautiful world filled with the best mini golf courses you’ve ever seen! Play by yourself, meet someone new, or challenge your friends in a private game with up to 8 people. Extremely realistic physics create the perfect experience for hardcore golfers and casual players alike.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel
summary: At Thors Military Academy, Erebonia’s best learn everything from the art of war to liberal arts. First year Rean Schwarzer learns he’s been selected to join the controversial Class VII, and they’ll need to deal with more than just class warfare--they’ll need to safeguard their country from chaos.

name: Sex, Secrets & Used Tech
summary: In this second-hand electronics shop, every discarded device holds unspeakable secrets. You will unlock privacy, manipulate information, and even use “special transactions” to make them submit to your terms… This is a game of desire and control—are you ready to make the trade?

name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
summary: Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
summary: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
summary: Relax in a cozy world filled with the magic of Disney and Pixar! Discover rich stories and build the perfect Valley alongside more than 50 heroes and villains in this life-sim adventure game.

name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels - Prologue
summary: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

name: BOMBANANA!
summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

name: Rune Factory 4 Special
summary: Journey to the vibrant world of Rune Factory and experience the legendary fantasy farming adventure like never before!

name: Christmas Stories: Puss in Boots Collector's Edition
summary: Why would anyone stop Christmas?

name: Dustland Delivery
summary: Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

name: Brutal Legend
summary: Brütal Legend is an action-adventure that marries visceral action combat with open-world freedom. Set in a universe somewhere between Lord of the Rings and Spinal Tap, it’s a fresh take on the action/driving genre, which in this case is full of imitation cover bands, demons intent on enslaving humanity and Heavy metal tunes.

name: Android Amazones
summary: A Small TPS game. Players become agents' Saya and fight with robots to rescue her younger sister Yui. After that, Yui rescues Saya, and Yui is so angry that she becomes a super something and explodes the enemy space battleship with a holy sword. A free soundtrack is included.

name: Life is Strange: Reunion
summary: The saga of Max and Chloe, and the fate of Caledon, is yours to decide! Play as both Max and Chloe as an all-new story builds towards an epic climax. The fire will force Max and Chloe to make devastating decisions. Can they find a future together… Before everything burns?

name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2
summary: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

name: Book Nook
summary: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

name: Castle on the Coast
summary: A hand-drawn, retro 3D collectathon. Parkour through a magic castle as George the Giraffe! String together sweet moves to explore crystal caverns, stone laden halls, and trippy alternate dimensions.

name: Crash Dive 2
summary: WWII Tactical submarine combat in the South Pacific

name: Sandustry
summary: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

name: Hotel Renovator
summary: Unleash your inner designer and renovate the hotel of your dreams! Embark on a makeover journey to turn this worn-out place into a successful getaway. Play with thousands of furniture pieces and accessories, and manage the hotel to get 5-star reviews!

name: Dysfunctional Systems: Learning to Manage Chaos
summary: From Dischan Media, creators of the highly acclaimed Juniper's Knot, comes Dysfunctional Systems: Learning to Manage Chaos.Dysfunctional Systems is a visual novel series featuring Winter Harrison, a student mediator from a utopian world. Learning to Manage Chaos is the first entry in the series.What is a mediator?

name: The Lightning Struck Orphan
summary: Build a deck of spells, create devastating synergies and defeat The Lightning Struck King.

name: Football Academy Simulator
summary: Run your own football academy! Create personalized training programs, improve your players' skills, rent out equipment, keep your facilities clean, and manage your sports shop. Build a squad from your best trainees and take your academy to the top of the Fantasy League.

name: Fireboy & Watergirl 4: The Crystal Temple
summary: Help Fireboy and Watergirl explore the Crystal Temple, the fourth game in the series. Play solo or team up with a friend locally or via Steam's Remote Play Together!

name: Laser Attraction
summary: Play with lasers and solve puzzles in Laser Attraction. Use reflection, refraction, dispersion and filtration to direct the laser beams, mix and separate colours, open doors, hit targets and complete puzzles.

name: Keyboard Soldier
summary: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fend off hordes of zombies by typing words, level up to unlock powerful items, and strategize to survive as long as possible in an ever-challenging environment.

name: Parking World: Build & Manage
summary: Build, manage, and expand your own lucrative parking enterprise in this management sim. Parking World puts the power to build your perfect parking garage at your fingertips while solving everybody else's parking problems in unique narrative scenarios or without any objectives in freeplay mode.

name: Dance Dash
summary: Arcade-style rhythm pumping FREE FULL BODY TRACKING on VR & PC. Empowered by mobile/webcam AI tracking. Groove to 100s of community songs and maps IN-GAME plus viral dance videos and MVs.

name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
summary: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

name: Canyons
summary: Canyons is a third-person action shooter set in a procedurally generated world. Fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players, command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world.

name: From Soil to Bottle
summary: Experience the art of winemaking like never before From Soil to Bottle. Dive into a realistic sandbox simulator where every decision shapes your wines. With endless possibilities, embark on a journey to become the ultimate winemaker!

name: City Bus Manager
summary: Build your own bus depot from scratch and create your personal bus routes in City Bus Manager. Play in your own hometown or any famous city in the world with real map data. Buy buses, maintain them, take care of your staff and lead your bus company to become the #1 in town!

name: Eye of the Temple
summary: Embark on a VR adventure to explore a vast and treacherous temple and uncover the ancient legend of the Eye. Keep your balance as you step between moving blocks, dodging hazardous traps and solving environmental puzzles with just your torch and whip in hand.

name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
summary: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

name: Hakoniwa Base Ball
summary: A front-office baseball management sim modeled on Japan's pro baseball (NPB) — no action. Run the draft, free agency, trades, contracts, scouting and stadium finances; simulate a season instantly or watch it pitch by pitch. Up to 30 teams, 6 leagues, all editable via CSV.

name: Crystal Maidens: Unleashed
summary: A twisted wizard has corrupted the Maidens and their land. It’s up to you to summon your own harem of stunning waifus, fight back against the dark forces, and liberate them in this lewd RPG adventure. Let your desires get unleashed!

name: Abyssal Trench
summary: Abyssal Trench is a first-person underwater horror game where you play as a lone explorer waking from cryo-sleep after a failed mission. With your pod out of fuel and your crew gone, a mysterious AI voice guides you to collect data from three abandoned drilling sites deep beneath the ocean.

name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
summary: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

name: Atlas Fallen: Reign Of Sand
summary: In solo or co-op, experience Reign of Sand, the ultimate version of Atlas Fallen. Ride the sands of a timeless land and defeat legendary monsters in spectacular Action-RPG combat using devastating powers.

name: Treasure of Nadia
summary: Meet gorgeous women! Find long lost treasure, explore the ancient mysteries that surround the island and build your own harem in Treasure of Nadia!

name: Laser Tag Massacre
summary: "Laser Tag Massacre" is a narrative-driven horror game inspired by 80s slasher movies, with a PS1-style aesthetic. On Halloween night, five friends throw a party in an abandoned arcade deep in rural Campinas, Brazil. What begins as a fun game of laser tag quickly spirals into their worst nightmare.

name: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
summary: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

name: Fly Corp
summary: Develop your own transport network in different regions and cities: open new routes, buy and upgrade new planes, and increase airport capacity!

name: Jungle Jim
summary: An action/adventure 2D platformer game focus on exploration

name: Beastfolk Barber
summary: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

name: Jurassic Park: Survival
summary: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.

name: Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE
summary: No matter how much times passes... I remember that blue, blue summer. Summer Pockets, the midsummer story brought to you by Key, has been powered-up with even more to play, including new heroines and routes, in Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE, now available on Steam!

name: The Killing Stone
summary: Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century occult horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

name: Mercenary Warriors
summary: Mercenary Warriors is a Turn Based PVP Strategy Game set in a fantasy world. Create your own team selecting 9 of the multiple warriors available to you and rise to the top.

name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

name: Rune Factory 5
summary: As the newest ranger of a peacekeeping organization known as SEED, protect your community by rounding up rowdy monsters and going on special missions. Cultivate your farm and friendships alike while unravelling rune-related mysteries!

name: Devil Daggers
summary: Devil Daggers is a fast-paced shooter that places you in an abyssal arena to face endless legions of demons. Armed with versatile magic daggers and a fluid movement system, fight to survive as long as you can.

name: ShadowComm. Associate Studio: Enterprise Edition
summary: ShadowComm. Associate Studio is the premier virtual loadout management and photography suite, built for the modern ultracorporate woman.

name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
summary: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

name: Travel VR
summary: “If we were meant to stay in one place, we would have roots rather than feet!”

name: Agent Sirius
summary: Join Beni Akesuzu, the high school detective president and secret agent, in this thrilling mystery RPG! Investigate mysterious incidents, solve puzzles,and uncover a sinister plot as monsters lurk in the shadows in a race to save the school and it's students before it’s too late!

name: Cyborg Rage
summary: Cyborg Rage is a multiplayer space shooter featuring cooperative online action. Work with your brave wingmen to destroy all hostile starships before they destroy you. Master the advantages of your ship and defeat your enemies!

name: Rune Dice
summary: A physics-driven roguelite deckbuilder that's easy to pick up and hard to put down. Launch dice to trigger satisfying chain-reaction merges. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

name: Rain98
summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

name: 100 Crime Cats
summary: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

name: Bound By Flame
summary: You are a mercenary possessed by a flame demon in a desperate world ravaged by seven Ice Lords. In this RPG where every choice counts, you will have to choose between unleashing the powers of the beast within and rejecting its demonic influence.

name: Mr. Cloak
summary: Be the first to explore the uncharted labyrinth beneath the city of Dravaneth as Mr. Cloak. Use stealth and wit to uncover its secrets, evade deadly traps, and chart your own escape route. Every level has multiple exits, unlocking new paths, areas, and dangers in your journey to survive.

name: 1999TOKOYO Building
summary: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

name: MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice
summary: SMASH through your foes in MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice and dive into variety of game modes where you can experience thrilling 3v3 battles, hero training, and the climactic Final War!

name: GONE Fishing
summary: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

name: Paluah's Trench
summary: An underwater narrative horror game where you must journey to the bottom of a deep-sea trench and uncover its mysteries.

name: Tactical Commanders R
summary: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

name: Travellers Rest
summary: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

name: Colony Survival
summary: Colony Survival is a unique first-person strategy game developed by a two-man team. Build your own colony in a voxel world. Command guards, farmers, miners and other colonists. Defend your colony against the horde of monsters that attacks every night!

name: Pronoun Palace
summary: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

name: Deadly Delivery
summary: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 5 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans. (VR crossplay supported)

name: Cloud Cutter
summary: Cloud Cutter brings you classic arcade shoot ‘em up gameplay in top notch graphics. Enjoy intense fast-paced explosive action full of epic destruction, arcade style power-ups, lasers and of course huge multi-stage boss fights.

name: Combat Mission Battle for Normandy
summary: Combat Mission Battle for Normandy faithfully recreates the experience of tactical land warfare in Western France during World War Two.

name: Farming Simulator 15
summary: Welcome to the new generation of Farming Simulator!With a brand new graphics and physics engine, Farming Simulator 15 offers an immense open world, filled with details and visual effects transporting the Farming Simulator franchise to a new era.

name: Ultrapolis
summary: A cyberpunk city diorama with millions of possible buildings. No city management between you and pure layout and design.

name: Rhythm Hotel
summary: Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game where history's most famous figures check in, and all hell breaks loose. bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. No skill barriers, no finger-melting difficulty: simple controls, catchy beats, and pure foot-tapping chaos.

name: Eclectic Expansion Enterprise
summary: Expand among the stars! It is 72k years in the future, and a new wave of Human expansion abounds. Join the ranks of the Ecxos, prep star systems for habitation, and develop your tools and ships to enterprise ever faster and further.

name: Extreme Escape
summary: Extreme Escape is an escape-room puzzle game with an action component. It combines realistic graphics with challenges at high altitudes. The player must find his way out of a critical situation by facing difficult weather conditions, technical problems and the fear of heights.

name: Capital Simulator
summary: A game that simulates the use of capital to build a complex industrial chain, stock investment and business challenges

name: Daily Android Doll
summary: Manage your own bionic girlfriend rental shop! Recruit and upgrade unique android companions, investigate customer secrets, negotiate prices, and match rentals perfectly. Maintain their sanity, prevent dangerous breakdowns, collect Awakening Soul Chips, and create your ultimate cyber girlfriend.

name: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking
summary: In this absurd co-op horror game you are medieval monks--and the only chefs who can prevent the apocalypse. Feed enormous monsters with a catapult, evade supernatural enemies, and navigate a reality-bending labyrinth with up to 4+ players!

name: WATER ZERO
summary: The water never stops rising. Water Zero is a high-stakes survival platformer about an unstoppable vertical escape. Control a robot, execute precise mechanical moves, dodge deadly obstacles, and reach the top before you get submerged. Every second matters.

name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
summary: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?

name: Huangguoshu Waterfall in Guizhou
summary: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

name: Clue: Murder By Death
summary: A story-rich detective mystery set in 1930s England. Investigate a murder inside a sprawling manor, interrogate suspicious residents, and make meaningful choices to uncover the truth — before Scotland Yard arrives.

name: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
summary: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

name: Red Soil
summary: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

name: I Know a Guy: Shady Life Simulator
summary: Run your pizza shop up front and handle shady business out back. Help hand-crafted NPCs with favors that never go as planned. Play solo or online co-op with up to four players and expand your operation across Hobarey Town. In this darkly comedic management sim - become that guy everyone knows.

name: The Pond
summary: Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

name: Spirits' Creek
summary: Spirits’ Creek is a third-person horror adventure where, following an avalanche, you play as a father looking for his daughter. Battle supernatural creatures, tame the elements and solve the mystery surrounding the events in order to survive the night.

name: Takara Cards
summary: Takara Cards is a unique tactical deck-builder RPG about chasing space dragons in a sci-fi fantasy universe. Create your deck as you explore sectors, fighting your way in deep puzzly combat. Every decision you make affects your Ship and Character: Each new adventure offers new surprises!

name: Paleo Dive
summary: Explore five prehistoric oceans on desktop or in VR. Photograph 48 species from three perspectives, collect DNA samples, and expand your walk-in aquarium. Upgrade your equipment and return to base before your oxygen runs out.

name: Hypernet Explorer
summary: Roguelike immersive sim set in esoteric post Y2K Europe.

name: Company Captain: Westashes
summary: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

name: Timeloop: Sink Again Beach
summary: A non-linear first-person action adventure in a pirate setting. A single player time travel simulation game. Unusual gaming experience.Moving in space and time, the player must understand what is happening on the island and how the main character can move away from there.

name: Rock Bottom
summary: Mine. Smelt. Upgrade. Repeat. Rock Bottom is an incremental mining game where every swing makes you stronger. Descend through 8 unique layers, unlock devastating abilities, and discover what lies at Rock Bottom

name: Hotel Galactic
summary: Welcome to Imoshima - an island floating in the clouds! Run a cozy intergalactic hotel where everyone wants to return. Build, decorate, cook, and discover the stories of your cosmic guests. It's a game about friendship set in a hand-drawn world inspired by iconic Japanese animation.

name: Grandma Left Me A Building
summary: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

name: Myth of Empires
summary: Myth of Empires is a multiplayer war sandbox game featuring a high degree of freedom and multiple civilizations. Players must survive, craft, create, and lead troops in their quest to conquer PVE or PVP territory and build their own empire. Xizhou Civilization Pack is now officially released!

name: Monk Took Book
summary: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
summary: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

name: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition
summary: Ready the Peashooters and prepare for the craziest, funniest shooter in the universe: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

name: Tunnel Heist
summary: Rent a dying laundromat next to First City Bank. Every night, dig. Haul the dirt out unseen, shore up the ceiling before it caves in, and keep quiet when the patrol car rolls by. One city block, one tunnel, one shot at the vault.

name: Desert Golfing
summary: Golfing across an endless desert.

name: Tactical Annihilation
summary: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

name: Sniper Ghost Warrior 3
summary: Go behind enemy lines with the ultimate modern military shooter. Play as an American sniper dropped in Georgia, near Russian border. Choose your own path to accomplish your missions across an unforgiving open world.

name: Let's Build a Zoo
summary: It's time to Build a Zoo! Construct and decorate enclosures, buy and breed animals, hire zookeepers and vets... then try your hand at DNA splicing, and stitch together over 300,000 different types of animal. This can only go smoothly...

name: Noctus Quarry
summary: Noctus Quarry is Motherload meets Path of Exile. A sci-fi themed mining ARPG where you upgrade your vehicle to explore a dangerous underground world full of creatures, minerals and ancient artifacts. Try not to get eaten whilst you work for the Empire.

name: Spear Dive
summary: Take up your spear in this first-person freediving simulator. Study fish behavior, manage oxygen and body temperature, and upgrade your gear to dive deeper. Explore seas that change daily with temperature, turbidity, and waves. Complete your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

name: Beastie Bay DX
summary: Develop a deserted island and collect rare monsters!

name: Crafting Dead
summary: Crafting Dead is a post-apocalyptic multiplayer-based zombie survival game with a voxel theme. Aim high and punch low, survive at all costs!

name: Float Night
summary: Float Night is a small sandbox game that is easy to collect resources, simple to build, no craft, and sustainable.

name: One Arrow
summary: Freeze your arrow in midair and then use it as a platform in this challenging precision platformer. Carve your own paths, outsmart your enemies, and uncover the secrets of your magic arrow.

name: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure
summary: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 13,196 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

name: Super Ledgehop: Double Laser
summary: Cutie anime girl realizes her cool big bro is missing?? Cheese it up with Chizuru and SHOOT TO THE BEAT OF THE SONG in this top down bullet hell shooter! Absorb enemy bullets using your waveshines to utilize their bullets as your own! Show those cheeseheads that you're better!

name: Paradise Marsh
summary: Stars vanished from the sky and scattered across a perfect endless wetland... Catch bugs and chat with many characters while playfully wandering through peaceful scenery. But don't lose sight of the night sky, the constellations need help!

name: Delta Force: Task Force Dagger
summary: As the US army's elite special operations soldiers you are the most potent 'smart weapon' known to man. You are the 'tip of the spear' for covert operations around the world — you are the first line of attack. Nothing stands in your way.

name: Statue Defender
summary: Defend the statue from being destroyed by waves of enemies. Choose your class. Level up. Customize your hero. Earn achievements and show the world you are the number one statue defender!

name: RedCloak
summary: The story of Little Red Riding Hood begins in the forest with her companion Light in an unfamiliar place with no memory. Enjoy a full-scale side-scrolling action RPG with tough boss battles where even a moment of inattention can kill you, and uncover the truth about the lost world.

name: Banners of Ruin
summary: Assemble your party. Answer the call. Win the war. Build a deck and fight a series of turn-based combats with up to 6 party characters through the city of Dawn's Point. Each character can unlock a set of unique cards and abilities that can augment your deck in powerful, exciting ways.

name: Marsh Into the New Dimension
summary: Delve into a new adventure... and some new dimensions. Marsh Into the New Dimension is a thrilling 3D boss-rush platformer adventure game travelling through brand new worlds and meeting new friends to help you save the universe from unwanted destruction. With a fresh new and original soundtrack!

name: Cyborg Arena 2
summary: Armed with your minigun, complete all the missions and unleash your firepower on the cyborgs! Keep moving and achieve the best online score !

name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
summary: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

name: Order of the Sinking Star
summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

name: Beach Invasion 1944
summary: Defend the fortified beach during D-day against invading forces in this WW2 FPS game as the enemy attacks you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic WWII weapons such as MG42, Flak88 and Panzers, prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

name: Breath of Fire IV
summary: Master an array of skills and magic to unlock strategic victories in battle as you go head to head with unique enemies using powerful "Dragon Transformations" and combo actions! Follow the intertwining stories of Ryu and Fou-Lu to their thrilling conclusion in this classic RPG adventure.

name: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
summary: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2
summary: In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

name: Hammer 2
summary: Hammer 2 is an action game in the third person where you will incarnate Hammer a hero of modern times! Take your rifle and kill anyone who gets in your way!

name: Voidling Bound
summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

name: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
summary: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you…

name: The Marsh Manor Mystery
summary: Something strange happened in the old manor, but the Pond's premier puzzle-solver is here to uncover the truth. In this ribbiting and cozy mystery, explore the grounds, journey into the past, and unearth the secrets buried at Marsh Manor.

name: MudRunner VR
summary: Take the wheel in this ultimate off-road automotive experience designed for VR, with all-new vehicles and tools to navigate harsh landscapes.

name: Football Agent
summary: You're not the manager, you're the agent. Scout hidden gems across 47,500 players, win them over face to face, build their careers, and sell them for millions. A deep football agency career sim where every contract has your name on it.

name: Moonstone Island
summary: Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

name: Red Bow: Strange Dream
summary: Embark on an immersive adventure alongside Roh as she tries to break free from her strange dream.

name: Cricket Captain 2026
summary: Build your dream team with Cricket Captain 2026. Forty-five new playable domestic teams across Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Ireland, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, plus match engine and 3D highlights improvements, editor customisation, and faster gameplay throughout.

name: Clay Soldiers
summary: The war rages on, choose to side with the Mercenaries, the Undead, the Angels, and more! Play through the single-player campaign, unifying the factions. Fight against other players and AI in the battleground's mode! Or strive for a conquest that takes you through the ages in war mode.

name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
summary: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

name: Lost Castle 2
summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

name: Mars Base
summary: Welcome to Mars Base, humanity’s foothold on the Red Planet! Join the expedition as an interstellar botanist and make history: turn barren soil into fertile farmland, grow food for colonists’ tables, and unearth the secrets of Mars! Are you ready to science the “crop” out of everything?

name: Waterfalls Dream
summary: Waterfalls Dream is an expressive diorama-builder with realistic water behavior. Build your own cozy waterfalls and watch water find its path among the nature scenery. Relax without any goal and paint in a 3D world full of procedural helpers. Imagine a new place - or recreate the one you saw before.

name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake
summary: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

name: Trucker Joe 2
summary: Transport various goods to companies with your truck! Expand your fleet with trucks and trailers to keep the industry running. In this mix of simulation and strategy, you decide where companies are built—plan wisely, shorten your routes, and dominate the logistics market!

name: SAND: Raiders of Sophie
summary: In SAND you build your highly customizable walking mech fortress. Squad up or go solo. Scavenge the dunes, gather loot, weapons, priceless artifacts, survive and extract. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert set in an alternate 1910.

name: Artifact
summary: Adult Lovecraftian strategy. Stealthily transform your university into horny, blonde bimbos! Dynamically change genitalia and breast sizes, IQ, mind control your peers via eldritch powers or eldritch parasites, erase your competition, and avoid a mysterious rival faction!

name: Wild Dive
summary: Reach the highest score by dodging obstacles, leaping across ravines, sliding down slopes, etc ... Watch your step!

name: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
summary: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
summary: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

name: Tenta Shooter
summary: Here comes a shoot-em-up game with a unique theme, tentacles! Defeat gigantic monster girls using a powerful bullet counter system!

name: Crawling Lab
summary: Stock up on ammo, upgrade your guns, defeat the Crawling Queen's minions and escape the lab.

name: Wind Up
summary: Wind Up is a multiplayer game focusing on social deduction, cooperation, and betrayal. In a complex haunted castle, the clockwork dolls outsmart imposters hiding among them. Who can escape the castle? Who will be banished? Who will be killed by imposters when night falls...

name: Half Sword
summary: Half Sword is a physics-based medieval combat simulator featuring historically accurate XV-century arms and armor. We are not afraid to show the brutal nature of medieval combat with in-depth blood and gore features.

name: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions
summary: Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

name: Meteor World Actor: Badge & Dagger
summary: Superpowered detective noir. Maverick detective Ruka Hiryu pursues criminals by day⁠—and ices perps by night...

name: Quick Race
summary: Everything you need to do is very simple – just race and over take every other car on the track to win the race! Quick Race is a simple racing game where you can compete with AI or on a split screen with your friend.

name: Zone Nova
summary: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

name: Plump! Dumb Frog Pond
summary: The future is chaos - frog attacks everywhere! You're a frog farmer in Potato Pioneer Town, build pond setups to attract different ugly frogs, then snatch them up in your bucket - Yoink! Toss your catches into tanks, fatten them up, and sell for big bucks.

name: Studio System : Guardian Angel
summary: An investigation of a secret film studio underneath their school has led 3 students down an estranged rabbit hole. With the fixed-camera as your weapon, shine a light on the truth and save your friends.

name: Need for Speed™ Most Wanted
summary: The open-world action in Need for Speed Most Wanted gives you the freedom to drive your way. Hit jumps and shortcuts, switch cars, lie low or head for terrain that plays to your vehicle’s unique strengths. Fight your way past cops and rivals using skill, high-end car tech and tons of nitrous.

name: Boots Quest DX
summary: An offbeat adventure game about traveling to the ends of the earth in search of the Best Boots. Solve puzzles, complete quests, collect items, and don weird hats as a hapless young boot enthusiast in a compact open world full of strange friends and foes. You can even jump.

name: Family Time
summary: You and your friends crash your car and find yourselves in the wilderness with a fox mama. Raise a family of thousands of fox children with her, and teach them how to farm, build, hunt, and more! 1-4 player experience.

name: Banana Shooter

summary: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game, but be ready to face the consequences.

summary: Build a criminal empire from the streets up. Commit crimes in third-person, run and automate illegal businesses, recruit your own crime family, fight rival organizations, and take control of a seamless open-world city.

name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4

summary: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

summary: A new threat descends upon the Overworld...

name: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE
summary: Square Enix and Tri-Ace present the latest title in the Star Ocean RPG series.

name: Learn to Fly 3
summary: Build your spaceship from scratch, earn funds and invest them into building a bigger, better spaceship as you try and fly your way up to space!

name: Zombie Army 4: Dead War
summary: Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter from the makers of Sniper Elite 4! Abominable occult enemies, epic weapons and a harrowing new campaign for 1-4 players await in 1940s Europe, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!

name: Dying Light: The Beast
summary: BECOME THE BEAST. SURVIVE THE NIGHT. A terrifying new chapter in the Dying Light universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you.

summary: All the passion, beauty & intensity of pro motorsport merging the most iconic cars & circuits with a new benchmark in handling performance.

name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-
summary: A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series. Packed with the challenge, tension, and rewarding gameplay of a classic roguelike adventure, this is a journey we're excited for a new generation of players take on!

Dan follows the clues found in the temples which leads him on a trip across the world, bringing him ever closer to making a sensational discovery.

summary: Take the loot, pirates! Bounty Rush is a 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. Work with your team to capture the other teams' berries!

name: Potion Permit

name: Action Taimanin
summary: An intense, gorgeous hack-and-slash action RPG from the Taimanin fame!

name: Waterpark Simulator
summary: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

name: Building our Futature

name: Lost Girl Platformer
summary: Lost Girl Platformer is a thrilling 2D platform game where you play as a courageous girl. Your task is to jump from platform to platform to survive and escape. But be careful: time is limited, and every jump must be precise!

name: Arrow Heads
summary: Grab your friends, neighbors, extended family and that handsome cashier from the grocery store and get ready for some sweet, award-winning, couch and online multiplayer. With your trusty bow, shoot, dodge and deflect arrows in this zany isometric archery game.

name: My Singing Monsters

Can you uncover the secrets of the Daisy Grotto?

summary: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

summary: The future of flight simulation is now! X-Plane 11 is the detailed, realistic, and modern simulator you’ve been waiting for. Intuitive user interface, 3-D cockpits, new effects, 3-D sound, living airports and world-wide scenery.

summary: Battle giant robots, mad gods, and…awkward teen romance? You were an ordinary high-school student—until you rescued a mysterious being from the army, and were granted amazing powers! Now you must put on your colored costume, make sure to finish your homework, and prepare for the fight of your life!

summary: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

name: Unclean Water
summary: Unclean Water is an FPS roguelike action game where you must escape the sewers of Marlene. Defeat Night Moss assassins using precise strikes, defense, smashes, and shield bashes to exploit enemy openings. Unlock a variety of furniture and items to turn your endless challenges into ultimate success.

name: Canyon Capers
summary: Canyon Capers is a retro style platform game brought right up to date, with tons of levels, modes, collectables and secrets.

While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

summary: Catapult yourself to incredible speeds in this first-person precision platformer. Use your command over vegetation to build up momentum and decimate the bugs in your way. Just be careful not to fall!

name: Backrooms: Escape Together
summary: A visually lifelike co-op horror game for 1-6 people. Journey through 11 procedurally generated levels, using what's available to survive and progress deeper into the Backrooms.

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos

name: War in the Gulf
summary: The Iraqi Republican Guard have overrun the oilfields of Northern Kuwait. War in the Gulf follows the fortunes of a crack unit of M1 tanks as the action unfolds.

name: Lost Totem Trajipon!
summary: Capture, command, and sacrifice occult mutants in a delightfully desolate, ultra-morbid turn-based RPG! It'll take a true Minion Master to unravel the treachery that's tying up Trajipon in this entirely above-board ROM we found at a garage sale!

name: BARDA: Backpack Roguelike
summary: In BARDA, it won't be your sword that saves you. It's how you pack your bag. But hunger, fatigue and madness will take up space! Do your best as you climb an ever-changing mountain to spread the ashes of your grandfather, improve your base camp, and try again.

name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
summary: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

name: Smoke and Steel
summary: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.

name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
summary: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you

name: Pirate101
summary: Assemble your ragtag crew and prepare to plunder the skyways in search of the legendary map to El Dorado! Danger lurks around every corner as you outsmart clockwork soldiers, uncover hidden mysteries, and unleash powerful combos in this pirate turn-based tactics MMORPG.

name: PICO PARK 2
summary: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

name: Flame and Blame
summary: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

name: Black Book
summary: “Black Book” is a dark RPG Adventure, based on Slavic myths, in which you play as a young sorceress. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures.

name: Hotel Architect
summary: Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage grand hotels around the world. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in Hotel Architect; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!

name: Heaven Will Be Mine
summary: Heaven Will Be Mine is a visual novel about making terrible life decisions in the midst of a hot-blooded battle between giant robots. Select one of three terribly behaved girls to fight and/or make out with each other in their struggle for the fate of space.

name: Void Stranger
summary: Place your faith and embrace the Void.

name: Witching Stone
summary: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
summary: Sam – with companions by his side – sets out on a new journey to save humanity from extinction. Join them as they traverse a world beset by otherworldly enemies, obstacles and a haunting question: should we have connected?

name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
summary: Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain & his crew. Engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and treasure.

name: Mythic Ocean
summary: Teach the gods to create a better universe - or mess it all up in Mythic Ocean, a narrative exploration game where your choices shape the fate of the cosmos.

name: Avernum 2: Crystal Souls
summary: Huge indie fantasy role-playing adventure in a massive, underground land. Packed with over 100 towns and dungeons and an epic story. Fight to complete up to three distinct game-winning quests. Master over 60 spells and abilities. Hunt for hundreds of magical artifacts. Over 50 hours of gameplay.

name: Grid Territory
summary: Use skills to attack monsters, occupy grids, expand your influence, and win battles!

name: The Slaverian Trucker
summary: The Slaverian Trucker is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game. Make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles.

name: Indie Dev Story
summary: Indie Dev Story - Quit your job to become an indie developer and make your first game!

name: Bow-Bots
summary: Bow-Bots is a VR Multiplayer Bow and Arrow Shooter with a unique item system. Shoot targets to gain powerful arrows or recharge your shields. The better your aim the better the reward.

name: Tactical Breach Wizards
summary: In Tactical Breach Wizards, you lead a team of renegade wizards in kevlar through turn-based battles to unravel a modern conspiracy plot. Combine their unique spells in clever ways, or rewind time to try every crazy plan you can think of to punch a Traffic Warlock through a 4th story window.

name: Slime Lab
summary: Become a slime scientist in your own VR lab and play with the most satisfying slimes! Experiment with fluid physics to create endless combinations, using unique colors and charms for your next customer.

name: Debauchery & Magic
summary: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

name: Regular Human Basketball
summary: Ready to play some ball? Grab a team, suit up, and climb inside your human! Prep its thrusters, lower the all-terrain wheels, and spin up that flailing magnet-arm. It's time to play Regular Human Basketball!

name: Gloves On!
summary: Pick up your gloves, wrap your hands, and put on your mouthpiece and headgear because Gloves On! is an action-packed boxing game with realistic and tactical controls. Get in the ring and fight an immersive and intense boxing match like you have never seen before.

name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
summary: Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

name: Sensual Adventures - Treasure Island
summary: Explore a tropical Island, find a lost Treasure, and have Sex with everyone along the way. Sensual Adventures - Treasure Island is an Adult RPG with both action-adventure gameplay and steamy Futanari romance.

name: Game of Thrones Winter is Coming
summary: Game of Thrones Winter is Coming is a PC strategy game based on the HBO drama television series, officially licensed by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment under HBO, and developed and published by YOOZOO Games. Interactive Entertainment and HBO.

name: Cruise Control
summary: It's time to set sail! Manage a cruise liner fleet, build entertainment and relaxation facilities, and tend to your guests needs at every turn. Work fast to solve problems, earn rewards, and ensure smooth sailing! Are you ready to turn on Cruise Control?

name: Puzzle Depot
summary: A box-pushing, bug-squishing, post-apocalyptic adventure awaits you in Puzzle Depot! Challenge hundreds of meticulously designed rooms that expand on classic sokoban gameplay with new and creative mechanics. Build your own devious creations with the included level editor!

name: The Temple of Elemental Evil
summary: Years ago a demoness’s elemental cult ruled from a temple near Nulb until the Circle of Eight razed it. Now bandits stalk Hommlet and dark forces gather at the ruins. In this classic party‑based D&D RPG, unmask their true purpose and confront the reborn evil before chaos engulfs the land.

name: Turbo Dismount™
summary: Turbo Dismount is a kinetic tragedy about Mr. Dismount and the cars who love him. It is the official sequel to the wildly popular and immensely successful personal impact simulator - Stair Dismount.

name: 18 Wheels of Steel: Extreme Trucker
summary: You ‘da Boss! Move it better and faster while staying alive. Build your reputation and your empire in the far corners of the world as you haul across the most extreme conditions and loads. Grab the wheel and hop in – is your heart pounding yet? Haul extreme cargo - from diamonds to oil pipes - across 3 death-defying terrains.

name: Moonglow Bay
summary: Embark on a journey as a rookie angler in Moonglow Bay, fulfilling your partner's final wish. Team up with friends, family, and neighbours to hone your fishing skills, nourish relationships, and restore a remote town's fractured community in this slice-of-life fishing RPG!

name: Shield Strike
summary: Shield Strike is a competitive game where players use shields as projectiles, in addition to the unique abilities of each of the 8 characters. Made for up to 4 players, VS or Coop, and with a challenging journey in story mode.

name: Cave Expedition
summary: The Ultimate Caving Simulator, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Experience dry and wet caving as you descend into tight squeezes, massive chambers, and uncharted depths. The deeper you go, the more upgrades & equipment you need ... and every decision matters!

name: Empires of the Undergrowth
summary: Command swarms of warriors at an unprecedented scale of warfare in this blend of RTS and base-building. Lead ant colonies against the many fearsome threats of the insect world, while building intricate nests, developing pheromone-based tactics, and evolving to meet growing dangers.

name: Volcano Watch
summary: Discover an open-world volcano-monitoring game grounded in accurate volcanology and authentic phenomena. Step into the role of a lone scientist facing an active volcano, and lead the adventure at your own pace, free to follow the story or carve your own path.

name: Puzzle Dimension
summary: Find solutions to 100 unique puzzles and experience the satisfaction of "Aha" moments!

name: Marsh
summary: Face-off against wacky, cartoony, brought-to-life objects in this 2D platforming shooter! Challenge your squishy self to get the highest of scores, up the difficulties and take back control of your non-living life.

name: Nightmare Grotto
summary: Nightmare Grotto is a horror-themed monster wave shooter for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. How long can you survive?

name: Mafia: The Old Country
summary: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.

name: ESA SHIELD
summary: Join the European Space Agency's SHIELD mission and discover why aliens aren't the biggest threat to us! In this science-based Planetary Protection Simulator, you fight real cosmic hazards. Build, Monitor, Protect! Become Earth's Last Defense.

name: LIVING HELL
summary: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

name: Cozy Keep: Farm, Craft, Manage
summary: Your father's life depends on your success. Run a medieval shop, craft goods, set prices, and build your reputation - because the King's debt collectors are coming. Farm, hunt, explore, and trade your way to freedom in this cozy but consequential shop simulation.

name: Grim Hammer
summary: Stop the stone golem and his army using powerful upgrades. Crush enemies with your hammer, earn gold, and unlock new abilities to defeat waves of monsters.

name: Cyborg3003
summary: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Cyborg, monsters and aliens. Free updates

name: The Message from Deep Space
summary: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

name: Cloud Meadow
summary: Equal parts farming simulator & turn-based RPG, Cloud Meadow lets you romance monsterfolk, cook tasty dishes, and explore uncharted lands!

name: The Cave Diver
summary: A brutally challenging physics-horror caving game. Using only your hands, drag yourself down a suffocating cave system where every hold pulls you further into the darkness. Equal parts rage-game, claustrophobic nightmare, and descent into a forgotten folktale...

name: Monster And Continent
summary: Defeat monsters to earn gold, upgrade stats, and push toward the Final BOSS! When gold isn't enough, use Crystals from Rebirths for massive power boosts and new skills. Conquer all maps, and an even greater challenge awaits in New Game+!

name: Medal Mania: Coin Pusher
summary: Drop coins. Push them forward. Grow your fortune. Get stronger. A fresh take on the 3D physics-based coin pusher, combining random skill choices, rare coins with unique abilities, and idle progression.

name: Fantasy World Manager
summary: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

name: Gems of War - Puzzle RPG
summary: Gems of War is a Match-3 RPG from the original creators of Puzzle Quest! Start your RPG journey and fight puzzle battles through hundreds of quests, or build your army of troops and go to war in strategic PVP match-3 combat!

name: My Building
summary: Look at your building. Watch your building. Earn item drops. It's yours to experience!

name: Infinite Cards
summary: Discover infinite cards in this roguelike deckbuilder. Every card is unique, every run a new experience. Craft, combine, and build your deck completely freely to defeat enemies and bosses, or take on cleverly designed puzzle challenges!

name: Blood Job
summary: Following a bizarre misunderstanding, you find yourself as the city's vampire overlord.... You'll be trained in combat by three beautiful vampires to face the enemies who want to destroy the order of the city. But you'll also have to battle issues from your past life, your life as a human.

name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
summary: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

name: Alter Cosmos
summary: Experience comic book style adventure with Aliencat in a world taken over by a totalitarian system. Find a way through dangerous situations, gather your crew and prepare a ship and escape into cosmos – an infinitive space where everything is possible. Unlock the secrets of The Waves of Distortions.

name: Violence of Action
summary: Command squads in real time, pause to coordinate complex assaults, or instantly take direct control of any soldier or vehicle. Fight across destructible battlefields in a procedurally generated World War II-inspired tactical campaign.

name: Void Crew
summary: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 6 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

name: Blue Swift Wind
summary: A vibrant arcade plane racer! Battle with power-ups across 12 stylized tracks, from serene to chaotic scenic routes. Use power-ups and master drifting in dynamic weather to become the swiftest pilot in this stylized, anime-inspired world, With more free tracks arriving in future updates.

name: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
summary: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

name: Startup Company
summary: Startup Company is a business simulation sandbox game where you’re the CEO of a new company. Your job is to build your very own website and compete against the largest tech giants on the planet!

name: Rocket Rumble
summary: Rocket Rumble is a 4 player party racing brawler where crossing the finish line first isn't the only goal! Smash your way through action-packed tracks, earning points along the way. Earn the most to win! Plus with procedurally generated obstacles in every track, you'll never know what's coming up!

name: Capital City
summary: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

name: Alan's Automaton Workshop
summary: Alan's Automaton Workshop is an open-ended programming puzzle game. Start a new business with Alan Turing and his groundbreaking innovation: the Turing Machine. Build unique automatons, and solve all kinds of problems from clients.

name: Sudoku Mansion
summary: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.

name: YoloX - Crosshair System
summary: YoloX is your complete FPS aim toolkit. Add custom crosshairs, zoom, sonar, motion feedback, inverted color, and more. Fully editable, Workshop supported, and designed for anti-cheat safety.

name: Escape Simulator
summary: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

name: Ghost Restaurant
summary: In a melancholic first person narrative puzzle game, you are the Memory Chef of a mysterious restaurant for lost souls. Explore their memories, solve story driven and logic based puzzles, uncover deep regrets, and serve their final meal to bring them peace.

name: Charm Studies
