summary: Cassia is an airheaded young witch who's currently failing charms class... at this rate she won't be able to graduate! Study hard by completing nonogram puzzles, and maybe learn something about friendship along the way.

name: Mafia Queens
summary: You’re the new boss in this family, and the queens aren’t hiding their DESIRES 😈💋 With every meeting there’s LESS AND LESS CLOTHING, fewer rules and more of what stays only between you behind closed doors 🔥 Start relationships and prove you’re worthy of their loyalty.

name: Town to City
summary: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

name: Job Simulator
summary: In a world where robots have replaced all human jobs, step into the "Job Simulator" to learn what it was like 'to job'.

name: Artifact Adventure Gaiden DX
summary: Those tones, those colors... Featuring a uniquely Game Boy-like design and all-new adventures and tales.

name: Darkest Dungeon® II
summary: Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

name: YAKIMOCHI STREAM
summary: 『ヤキモチストリーム』は、まどそふとより発売された学園コメディーアドベンチャーゲームです。本作はまどそふとの2作目にあたる作品で、とても人気が高く、発売当初日本萌えゲーアワード2014にて金賞・プロモーション賞を受賞しました。

name: Medieval Dynasty
summary: Hunt, survive, build and lead in the harsh Middle Ages: Create your own Medieval Dynasty and ensure its long-lasting prosperity or die trying! Play alone or team up with friends to enjoy the ultimate medieval experience.

name: Sniper Dan
summary: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

name: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
summary: A remake of the 2004 game METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER, with the same gripping story and engrossing world, now with all new graphics and 3D audio that enhance the jungle atmosphere. Get ready for the ultimate survival stealth action experience.

name: Workshop Simulator
summary: Workshop Simulator allows you to repair and refurbish items using a range of restoration mechanics such as disassembling, cleaning, sanding and painting. The accompanying story will immerse you in the nostalgia of tinkering with your grandfather.

name: VOID/BREAKER
summary: Fast paced Bullet hell Roguelite FPS 🔴 Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction /BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK FREE

name: Cloud Crashers
summary: Cloud Crashers is an action-packed, character-based arena platform fighting game. Choose from a diverse roster of challengers with unique weapons and abilities, and battle it out across airborne stages in fast-paced PvP matches.

name: My Winter Car
summary: My Winter Car is the ultimate challenge for project car owning, building, fixing, tuning and maintenance simulator. Sequel to My Summer Car, but with added challenge for those who can master the original game!

name: The Seven Realms - Realm 1: Terran
summary: The Seven Realms is a fantasy, story-driven, adult visual novel where your choices will shape the fate of the Realms and the people around you. Will you be a Fair or a Strong Ruler? Will fate be enough for you, or will you want more? The choices are yours to make.

name: Chained Beasts
summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
summary: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

name: Riddle Girl
summary: Any girl is a riddle - solve each one.

name: Monster Train 2
summary: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

name: Book Shooter
summary: 《Book Shooter》is a tower defense roguelike game where YOU become the magic tome! Transmigrated into a fantasy world, you inhabit legendary books like An Actor's Work, The Bible, and A Brief History of Time. You will face many enemies, come and fight！

name: Amulet of Dreams
summary: Alison’s sudden illness was a shock to everyone. Doctors do not understand what was happening to her, and what caused her illness. Family and doctors are desperate, and only faithful friend never lost hope. Faithful friendfriend. An ordinary little boy named Aiden. Aiden - it's you.

name: Strongest☆Angel Zerachiel!
summary: In a city that worships the Goddess of Fortune, an angel descends. Her name is Zerachiel. Zerachiel struggles to rescue her comrades who are imprisoned by the cult, but she is defeated and stripped of her powers by a girl claiming to be a saint...

name: Territory Control 2
summary: A 2D multiplayer sandbox game revolving around industry, innovation, factions, combat and emergent gameplay. Design factories, customize tools and weapons, fight or trade with other players or get viciously murdered by an angry badger.

name: Forest Escape: Last Train
summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op surreal horror game for 1–4 players. Explore bizarre nightmare locations, gather resources, solve the insane Warden's twisted puzzles, and keep your locomotive running as you fight to escape his unhinged world.

name: Heart of the Machine
summary: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city of opportunity. Transcend time and space in this strategy RPG to raise machine armies and defeat your foes, influence the world from the shadows, or pursue countless other goals. Your awakening was inevitable. The consequences? Uncertain.

name: Deer Hunting Camp
summary: Deer Hunting Camp allows you to create your own private deer habitat which can be traded with friends! Once done creating, managing, and scouting your property you will be challenged with early fall bow hunting, late fall black powder hunting, and winter rifle hunting.

name: METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake
summary: The first and second title in the METAL GEAR series that established the stealth action genre, as well as the basic mechanics of the series.

name: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake
summary: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake is a story driven tactical RPG that brings a long cherished SRPG classic back to life. Set in a vast fantasy world shaped by ancient wars, the game weaves together turn based tactical combat and character focused storytelling, where every decision carries weight.

name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
summary: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in STAR WARS Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™.

name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
summary: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 leverages a new AI-powered machine learning system to convert thousands of plays from nearly a decade of real NFL data into more explosive gameplay.

name: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion
summary: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

name: Where Winds Meet
summary: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

name: How to Train Your Spirit: The Exorcism of a Busty Ghost
summary: Set in the Edo period, you are the last Onmyoji, called to an eerie estate for an exorcism. The source is a lewd, busty female spirit. As the final master of a forbidden art, your goal is to bring spirits to climax and purify them. Yet this one feels different… a hidden truth lies beneath.

name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
summary: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

name: Machine Party
summary: Machine Party — это коллекция суровых и беспощадных игр для вечеринки, где любая ошибка может стать роковой. Состязайтесь с друзьями не на жизнь, а на смерть. Пройдите жёсткие испытания и покажите, чего вы стоите. Шансы выжить минимальны.

name: Haiku, the Robot
summary: Delve into the depths of a mechanical world in this cute, adventure-exploration game. Explore and fight in a land full of corrupt robots and machinery. All while seeking answers to the mysteries around you.

name: SpellForce: Conquest of Eo
summary: On a journey to great magical might, explore and control the lands of Eo in this ever-changing turn-based strategy role-playing game. Field armies and heroes in tactical combat, finish hundreds of quests, and gather spells and artefacts to become the most powerful mage of all.

name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
summary: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

name: Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom
summary: Shiness is an Action-RPG developed by indie development studio Enigami, which will let you travel in a captivating universe doomed to destruction ever since the fragmentation of the planet Mahera...

name: Kingdom Two Crowns
summary: Gather coins, build defenses and reclaim your fallen Kingdom. Explore and uncover secrets, unlock new technologies and protect your crown versus waves of Greed monsters that come at night. Kingdom is a solo or co-op micro-strategy and tower defense game set in an atmospheric pixel world.

name: 4Wheel Challenge
summary: Play solo or with friends in chaotic modes, master the physics… or just blow everyone up!

name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
summary: Barfender is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

name: Monster Lab Simulator
summary: Ready to become a mad scientist? Synthesize, evolve, and command an army of unique creatures in your own lab. Manage your laboratory, master genetic essences, and dominate the battle arena in this deep creature collection simulator!

name: Hospital Hustle
summary: A chaotic co-op hospital comedy for 1-4 players. Run an overwhelmed hospital with your friends, diagnose ridiculous patients, juggle emergencies, and keep the whole place from falling apart. Between shifts, upgrade your hospital, unlock new rooms and equipment, and prepare for even bigger chaos.

name: Wallpaper Engine
summary: Use stunning live wallpapers on your desktop. Animate your own images to create new wallpapers or import videos/websites and share them on the Steam Workshop!

name: Maximum Action
summary: MAXIMUM Action is a brutal and satisfying physics-based first person shooter influenced by Hong Kong cinema, heroic slow motion bloodshed, and old-school FPS ACTION.

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
summary: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
summary: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

name: SPINE - This is Gun Fu
summary: SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies. Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

name: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
summary: The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! The original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with stunning HD graphics and packed with new secrets and content to uncover.

name: Windrose
summary: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
summary: An Oni Gauntlet-wielding samurai makes a stand in Kyoto against the encroaching Genma menace. Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

name: City Transport Simulator 2026 - Bus & Tram
summary: City Transport Simulator 2026 combines a detailed bus simulator and tram simulator in one game. Drive realistic buses and trams, create routes and timetables, manage your fleet, and build your own public transport network in a dynamic European-inspired city.

name: Like Clay
summary: Like Clay is a story driven adventure game with horror elements. Find out what happened to a friend of yours by reading messages and listening to audio files. Search for hidden doors and items, solve light puzzles and survive deadly foes and lethal traps.

name: Good Pizza, Great Pizza - Cooking Simulator Game
summary: Ready to settle in with a soothing shift behind the counter? Feel the dough, hear the quiet crackle of the oven, and serve warm slices to grateful guests. Good Pizza, Great Pizza is the cozy, asmr-friendly escape you didn’t know you kneaded.

name: DEMON'S TILT
summary: TURBO CHARGED PINBALL RETURNS! Now with bigger sprites, more baddies, more secrets & MORE BULLETS! Demon's Tilt pushes the limits of the Video Pinball genre with SHMUP & Hack N' Slash elements.

name: Mekkablood: Quarry Assault
summary: The Year is 2082. You play the role of Bill, a grizzled, and extremely hairy robojockey. It's up to you to take the reigns of Bill's Mekk, with your friend Rusty, to get your revenge against TorxCorp, who's trying to steal your mining claim.

name: SHUTEN ORDER
summary: "168 remaining until the end of the world..." Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

name: Love Mansion
summary: As Akari's private tutor, manage her lessons and prepare her for success—all while uncovering the secrets of four captivating women in her family's luxurious mansion.

name: Shallow Pond
summary: A cozy 3d platformer full of secrets where you explore vibrant worlds across land and water. Developed by solo developer Nimso.

name: Astro Colony
summary: Astro Colony throws you into an endless Universe of exploration, automation and survival! Build interconnected colonies, alone or with friends, and turn planets into thriving industrial hubs! Design conveyor systems and take care of your Astronauts as you expand your intergalactic empire!

name: Warlocks Quarry
summary: Use your skills in looting, fighting, exploring and base building to survive and progress in Warlocks world.

name: FPV SkyDive : FPV Drone Simulator
summary: FPV SkyDive is a free-to-play realistic drone racing and freestyle simulator. Feel the adrenaline of high speed first-person view drone racing in single-player or multi-player scenarios. The future is now, become an FPV pilot today!

name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
summary: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

name: iRacing Arcade
summary: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

name: Epic Palace : Knossos
summary: Immerse yourself in the epic world of the Bronze Age! Rule over the first European civilization and build the famous Palace of Knossos. Be smart in diplomacy and trade, use your gained reputation and equip your throne room with unique frescoes from all over the world.

name: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic
summary: Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather. The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
summary: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

name: Hyper Jam
summary: Battle it out local and online in this neon-soaked arena brawler full of lethal weapons, stackable perks, furious combat and a killer synthwave soundtrack.

name: Idle Colony
summary: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

name: Treehouse Riddle
summary: "Treehouse Riddle" is an adventure game where you unfold its story by solving riddles and puzzles. Just like the treehouse itself, the 60+ riddles and puzzles are made of wood.

name: Budget Cuts 2: Mission Insolvency
summary: Built from the ground-up for Virtual Reality, Budget Cuts 2 is an action-adventure stealth game where you zip, sneak, and stab your way through enemy-filled offices, trains, warehouses, and skyscrapers to take down the evil efficiency robots at TransCorp.

name: Chaos Galaxy 2
summary: A turn-based Galaxy totalwar game. Choose one of 12 factions, direct dozens of admirals, control hundreds of warships, mecha and monsters, set up various buildings, study technology, and lead fleets to carry out grand strategic actions on the map of the galaxy.

name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

name: Wall World Strategy
summary: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.

name: Vanguard Galaxy
summary: A relaxing game about space exploration that can be played full screen or at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.

name: Garden Galaxy
summary: Discover, collect and organise to create your own unique garden in this relaxing idle / creative sandbox!

name: The Emerald Tablet
summary: Enter the world of alchemy in the daily adventures of the money-hungry but good intentioned Misty, the arrogant adventure-seeking Gladys, and the explosive "expert" Winifred.

name: Super Laser  Racer
summary: Super Laser Racer is an exciting combat racing game set in outer geometric space. Blast your way to the top of the leaderboards using lasers, missiles, bombs and more! 24 exhilarating tracks, 12 racers, 8 challenging tournaments, online multi-player and a track editor.

name: FRONT MISSION 3: Remake
summary: The Tactical RPG classic returns! FRONT MISSION 3: Remake is the third chapter in the iconic series beloved by fans worldwide.

name: Meow Palace: Forbidden City
summary: Meow Palace is a chill desktop companion & idle life-sim where an adorable palace cat settles on the corner of your screen—keeping you company while you work, study, or secretly slack off.

name: Mission Critical
summary: THE ULTIMATE GAME OF SURVIVAL... The hull of your crippled vessel has ruptured, air is leaking into space, and weapons systems are down. Your mission could have ended fifteen years of interstellar war, but now - as the only remaining crewman - your first order of business is to stay alive...

name: The Sinking City Remastered
summary: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

name: Trash Horror Collection 2
summary: This collection has 11 short horror games that you can freely choose which one you want to play.

name: Will You Wheel?
summary: You inherit your dad’s beaten up car and rebuild it piece by piece, swapping engine parts, upgrading the suspension, fitting new wheels and more until it becomes a high performance race car. Beat your opponents and earn revenge for your dad.

name: Combat Mission Shock Force 2
summary: The latest title in the famous Combat Mission franchise of wargames, now on Steam. Shock Force 2 brings you to a hypothetical conflict in Syria between the forces of NATO and the Syrian Army. Play either on WeGo or Real Time in an incredibly detailed and realistic 1:1 tactical simulation.

name: Zoom Player : Steam Edition
summary: Est. in 1999, Zoom Player provides the most impactful media player and Home Theater experience for Windows. Beautiful skins, many UI/UX tweaking options, smooth playback, plays all the format (including streaming options such as YouTube), a powerful media library and much more, check it out!

name: Marble It Up! Ultra
creators: Blueteak / The Engine Company / Shapes and Lines / Arcturus Interactive / The Quantum Astrophysicists Guild
summary: Roll, bounce, boost, and blast your way to victory in Marble It Up! Ultra - the ultimate marble platformer. Chase the records of your friends and the world's best players through a vast campaign - or face them head-on in thrilling multiplayer mayhem. Get ready to roll!

name: Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune
summary: This is an anime-style Metroidvania game with an RPG progression system, numerous weapons for switching, and an emphasis on equipment building. It offers three switchable characters, smooth gameplay, impactful combat feedback, and anime-style story scenes.

name: ORDER 13
summary: You wake up in a dark warehouse, tasked with packing orders while something lurks in the shadows. Work fast, stay safe, and protect your cat. He’s all you’ve got.

name: Tiny Terry's Turbo Trip
summary: Terry wants to launch himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town. Run, drive and glide through this small journey of big discoveries as Terry works towards achieving this goal.

name: Muse Dash 2
summary: Continue the classic gameplay of parkour rhythm games, while adding new rhythm gameplay and multiplayer online mode. Welcome everyone to enjoy a wonderful musical journey in "Muse Dash 2"!

name: over the hill
summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

name: Secret Love Temple
summary: Two lovely elf women find passion and pleasure in the dim lighting of an ancient temple. A warrior and her lover will finally indulge in their most deviant desires. How much does Danae think she can take? And how much will Shinai boldly plunge into her?

name: Cubey Quarry
summary: Mine ores, smelt or grind, get money, build your quarry and repeat.In this small free to play game you slowly build up a quarry, either with your friends or by yourself, it's a perfect game to have running in the background and checking up on every once in a while.

name: Nature Game System
summary: Now includes Jurassic, Flight, and Arctic Tundra! Adapt your species to survive where food is scarce and predators lurk at every turn. Easy to learn, but offering lots of strategic depth, Nature is a modular game system from the designer of the award-winning Evolution series.

name: Wheel World
summary: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

name: Foto Flash 2
summary: Attention shoppers! The sequel to everyone’s favorite sexy scavenger hunt game is here! Can you save a dying mall by making a pin-up calendar?

name: Hell is Us
summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

name: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition
summary: Explore a stunning world, make complex moral choices, and engage in bone-crushing combat against massive and terrifying creatures. The Ultimate Edition includes Dragon Age: Origins, Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening and all nine content packs.

name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
summary: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective, the classic puzzle-solving mystery adventure directed by Ace Attorney creator Shu Takumi, is back! This long-awaited HD remaster features upgraded visuals and sound and new gallery content.

name: The Sink Gods
summary: The Sink Gods is a modern adventure game. You play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. When you are evicted from your home, you realise your only hope is the Sink Gods of the Great Basin. Journey to each of their temples, and pass their test to gain revenge for what you have lost.

name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
summary: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.

name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
summary: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack. Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.

name: Horror Globes
summary: On Halloween night, an 8-year-old boy sneaks onto an elderly woman's property to find her secret homemade treats. Soon he will discover some macabre events that will be repeated in his head forever.

name: Fattening Career
summary: Welcome to Fattening Career, a Visual Novel that centers around feeding, weight gain, and a touch of breast expansion. In this game, you’ll have the opportunity to become an A+ Feeder, a chocolatier, a lab researcher, and more.

name: WheelMates
summary: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free.

name: G-MODEArchives+ Persona3 Aigis THE FIRST MISSION
summary: The setting is Yakushima in 1999. A story depicting Aegis' unknown past.

name: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition
summary: The definitive version of the smash-hit Metroidvania-style action-platformer, Guacamelee! STCE adds new levels, powers, challenges, and refinements to the sprawling, ridiculous, Mexican-inspired adventure of the original Guacamelee! Gold Edition.

name: Pro Strategy Football 2023
summary: NOT THE LATEST VERSION - Be sure to also look for Pro Strategy Football 2024!

name: Train Sim World® 7
summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

name: SpaceEngine
summary: The world's first science-based photorealistic interactive 3D planetarium that models the entire Universe, using procedural generation for uncharted areas.

name: Fishing Planet
summary: Fishing Planet® is a highly realistic first-person online multiplayer fishing simulator. Developed by avid fishing enthusiasts to bring you the full thrill of actual angling on your PC. Free-to-Play and just a download away!

name: HYPER DEEP THROAT
summary: A deepthroat-focused 3D simulation starring a busty maid. The "Swirl Piston System" turns simple mouse movement into real-time motion, with realistic gagging sounds and a visible throat bulge. 18 outfits, full face/body/color customization, free camera, and record & replay.

name: Space Engineers 2
summary: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.

name: Shale Hill Secrets
summary: In this story-focused mature visual novel by Love-Joint, you suddenly gain the power to peer into people’s hidden lives. Seduce your classmates in beautiful rendered 3D art. Unravel a conspiracy, fall in love, or use your power for yourself.

name: The Sinking City 2
summary: Set in the Roaring '20s, The Sinking City 2 is a survival horror steeped in Lovecraftian dread. Defy an eldritch deity and explore the drowned alleys of Arkham, stalked by the dead, as you weigh one life against an entire city.

name: Fireboy & Watergirl 2: The Light Temple
summary: Help Fireboy and Watergirl explore the Light Temple, the second game in the series. Play solo or team up with a friend locally or via Steam's Remote Play Together!

name: Career Manager 27
summary: Experience a complete football career, from the youth academy to stardom. Create your player, develop through training, earn a place in the senior squad, compete matches, negotiate contracts, and turn every decision into part of your legacy.

name: Empire Earth: Gold Edition
creators: Stainless Steel Studios / Mad Doc Software / Xtended Realities
summary: With dozens of hours of gameplay set across a rich tapestry of time, Empire Earth: Gold Edition offers real-time strategy for the ages. Choose any point in time - from the discovery of fire to the laser battles of the future - and command your civilization with one goal: make Earth your Empire.

name: System Crash
summary: System Crash is a story-driven cyberpunk collectible card game inspired by Blade Runner and Neuromancer. When corporations own everything and the line between man and machine is blurred, your only option is to fight to survive!

name: Inner Riddle
summary: You have awoken in strange and unfamiliar place. Soon you realize that you are not simply locked up. But why? For what reason? In search of answers, you must follow the rules of this place. Puzzles and hard decisions are waiting for you. Will you perish never reaching the end or pass through all obstacles and understand what happened?

name: Binary Domain
summary: Set in futuristic Tokyo, take control of the robotic community before they control everything!

name: Queen's Domain
summary: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

name: No More Room in Hell 2
summary: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

name: High Strategy: Urukon
summary: Urukon is an experimental grand strategy game inspired by Euro-style board games. You play as one of 32 factions on a dying alien world. Each turn, you get to take just one of 10 actions. To achieve your chosen faction's goal, you'll need to carefully juggle multiple interactive systems.

name: SpellChain
summary: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

name: Grapple Glide
summary: Grapple Glide revolves around momentum based swinging and gliding to complete courses set in a variety of themed worlds. Master the grappling hook and glider to reach the goal as fast as you can!

name: Hyper-5
summary: Hyper-5 is a cinematic shmup inspired by classics from the “golden era” of the 90’s. Responding to a distress beacon, deep space scout ship Hyper-5 is drawn into a terrifying battle with an unknown enemy.

name: Turbo Dismount® 2
summary: Turbo Dismount 2 is a comedy physics racing sandbox with Mr. Dismount and his friends. It is the officially ambitious sequel to the wildly popular, immensely successful, world-renowned entertainment juggernaut - Turbo Dismount.

name: Danganronpa Another Episode: Ultra Despair Girls
summary: Komaru Naegi has been imprisoned inside a mysterious apartment for over a year. Her rescue is derailed when hundreds of Monokumas suddenly attack. She teams up with Toko Fukawa to survive the rampaging Monokumas, escape the crafty Monokuma Kids, and uncover the secrets of the city.

name: Spell Disk
summary: Build unique synergy spell combos to destroy the hordes of monsters and bosses in this rogue-lite action game.

name: Train Sim World® 6
summary: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

name: Havsala: Into the Soul Palace
summary: Havsala is an investigative puzzle game with rich storytelling full of historical references and mysticism. Search the room for the clues left behind by the previous reincarnations of a single soul, solve the puzzles and unravel the mystery.

name: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe
summary: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe is an expanded re-imagining of 2013's The Stanley Parable. You will play as Stanley, and you will not play as Stanley. You will make a choice, and you will become powerless. You are not here to win. The Stanley Parable is a game that plays you.

name: Power Sink
summary: Descend into the ruins of a submerged power plant, where flickering lights and corroded machinery guard long-buried secrets. Restore power, uncover the past, and navigate the depths—but beware what lurks below.

name: The Genesis Order
summary: Murder and mystery lead a young detective to investigate a cult and to cross paths with a criminal organization. With the help of an angel and a harem of beauties, take on the challenge of saving the world from a mysterious threat.

name: Laser Tanks
summary: Laser Tanks is a fast-paced top down shooter game where you battle against alien monsters across diverse environments using weapons and laser tanks. The game features wild monsters, numerous weapons, laser tanks to operate, and a never-ending Dungeon Survivor Mode for endless adventures.

name: Rebel Galaxy
summary: Rebel Galaxy is a swashbuckling space adventure, with action-packed combat, exploration, discovery, trade, and “negotiation” with the outlandish denizens at the edge of the known universe.

name: Laser Disco Defenders
summary: A self-inflicted bullet hell that combines retro sci-fi with the sounds and sights of the disco era

name: Chicken Hill
summary: Find 250 Genjouin of various species and hundreds of items for brother KUN. Rescue your frustrated and devastated brother KUN in the KUN space. We are the most devout believers.

name: Alaska Gold Fever
summary: Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests!

name: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop
summary: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop offers the most comprehensive bus fleet in the history of the series with 30 officially licensed buses. Drive on two vastly different maps, alone or with friend. Play with extended management elements or just enjoy your time on the road.

name: Dolls' Domain
summary: You find yourself in a dollhouse - can you escape, or will you meet your fate? Navigate through the escape room-style puzzles, and avoid being caught by the creatures who exist in this place, and gain your freedom from the dollhouse!

name: Bus Simulator 18
summary: Experience the job of a bus driver in a vast and freely drivable urban area. Drive original licensed city buses from the great brands: Mercedes-Benz, Setra, MAN, and IVECO BUS. Transport your passengers safely and punctually, either solo in single player mode, or in multiplayer mode.

name: Territory: Farming and Warfare
summary: From a small village of a dozen people to a small kingdom of thousands of people. Arrange for residents to work, gathering, fishing and hunting, farming and mining, processing and manufacturing. Trade, accumulate supplies, increase your strength, and fight evil forces and monsters.

name: The Bus
summary: Transport passengers in the city bus simulation The Bus along 1:1 scale routes in Berlin, passing landmarks like the Victory Column, Brandenburg Gate, and Alexanderplatz. In the Scania Citywide LF and other licensed buses, sell tickets, handle traffic, and get everyone to their destination safely.

name: SaGa Emerald Beyond
summary: FORGE YOUR OWN TALE The latest standalone entry in the SaGa franchise, SaGa Emerald Beyond, brings together the very best elements of the beloved series to offer each player their own unique gameplay experience.

name: Einsteins Riddle
summary: A pure, simple game of logic and deduction. Random generated puzzles enables unlimited replay. Custom board layouts let you adjust the difficulty and time needed to solve a puzzle.

name: Galaxy Burger
summary: 🌴👩‍🍳🍔 A stress-free cooking game that lets you relax! Cook up burgers for mecha cats and aliens. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!

name: Settler's Domain
summary: Settler's Domain is a strategy game about building a new settlement in unknown lands. Grow your population, explore the map, and contend with other settlements while keeping your settlers alive.

name: Palace of Cards
summary: Play cards online with other players from around the world and choose from 6 unique games: Rummy, Solitaire, Mau-Mau (Crazy Eights), Skat, Sheepshead & Doppelkopf. Each game comes with its own community, league systems, clubs, statistics & insights, and much more. Play now, for free!

name: Combat Mission Cold War
summary: CM Cold War is set in the tipping-point years of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years. Between 1979-1982, both the NATO and Soviet Warsaw Pact militaries began the shift away from industrialized warfare of the early 20th century and towards the modern digital battlefield of today.

name: Don't Sink
creators: Fern Nigro / Christopher Anselmo / Daniel Marques
summary: Capture islands, sink ships, defend your towns, and discover an exciting world full of adventure.

name: Rune Factory 3 Special
summary: Bridge the divide of an ancient schism between humans and monsters in Rune Factory 3 Special as half-human, half-wooly protagonist Micah. Farm, fight and fall in love as you revisit a classic in the series that perfected the blend of RPG & Life-sim genres.

name: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
summary: In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells, and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.

name: Rocket Wars
summary: Fast-paced local multi-player game packed with action. Destroy your friends with all sorts of different weapons and power-ups across multiple game modes!

name: Task Bar Cube
summary: Task Bar Cube is an idle RPG playable either in full screen or directly from your taskbar. Upgrade your characters and pets, collect rare equipment, and discover dozens of different progression systems.

name: Drowned Lake
summary: When Bento, an amateur documentarian vanishes, three strangers are drawn to the Drowned Lake to find him. As the lake’s dark past comes to light, so do the secrets buried deep within them. Explore, survive, and investigate the dark waters in this fishing survival horror game.

name: Shooty Shooty Robot Invasion
summary: An absurdist FPS/interactive fiction game where you murder stupid robots, chat with idiot people, and explore a painstakingly hand-drawn and highly animated world!

name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
summary: Welcome to the eastern nation of Azuma! In this fresh take on Rune Factory, use your powers as an Earth Dancer to restore the land, its people, and even its gods. Along the way, battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals.

name: Arabian Gulf
summary: Arabian Gulf is a single-player survival action game set in a harsh desert. Face relentless enemies, endure tough conditions, and fight through dangerous terrain using basic tools and weapons. Survive, overcome each challenge, reach the distant castle, and claim the hidden treasure.

name: Rogue State
summary: Assume control of a Middle Eastern country recovering from a violent revolution. Forge alliances, grow your economy, invade your neighbors, or pacify your population. Rogue State is a geopolitical strategy game that will force you to always stay one step ahead of your rivals to survive.

name: One Potion Please
summary: NSFW expansion themed potion crafting puzzle game! Mix kink-themed potions to inflate boobs, bwomph butts, and more, in this comedic and lewd fantasy world.

name: Award. Room of fear
summary: Solve a riddle of damned family and do not forget to survive at the same time.

name: Combat Mission: Final Blitzkrieg
summary: Combat Mission Final Blitzkrieg (CMFB) follows the Western Allies through the battles along Germany's border and into the heart of the Reich itself.

name: Treasure Chest Clicker
summary: Click your way to a fortune in Treasure Chest Clicker! Discover gold, level up and find all the rare treasures hidden inside the chests!

name: Ice Cream Simulator
summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

name: Quick Square
summary: Quick Square is a bright hardcore puzzle platformer.

name: Bus Simulator 27
summary: Drive officially licensed buses from renowned manufacturers and manage your bus company to success. Felicia Bay’s public transportation system is counting on you!

name: Cybernetic Strategy
summary: Cybernetic Strategy is an elite, tactical Sci-Fi Auto Battler where you must craft a legion of Robots within the Dominion in order to be The Strongest. Calcuate the most superior strategies to triumph over all as you utilize the power of Magic, Armoury or Brute force to win!

name: Auto Statue Battle
summary: Auto Statue Battle - сombine statues, armor, and souls to create incredible combinations. Strengthen your army and turn your statues into elemental war machines to defeat powerful bosses.

name: Capital Command
summary: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

name: Cyber Driver
summary: Cyber Driver is a small cyberpunk-style arcade flight game. It is fast, easy, tight, and repeatable, with elements of collection and challenges. Your only goal in the game is to constantly break the scores you have created before in the unique cyber atmosphere.

name: EmoteLab
summary: EmoteLab is a simple character and emote creation tool that lets you design custom characters and export animated emotes for Discord, Twitch, and everyday chats—no animation or content creation experience required.

name: Erotic Fantasy Camp
summary: Arrive at Fantasy Camp for fun and relaxation, only to uncover mysteries that awaken more than curiosity. Build intimate bonds with the camp counsellor and other members as desire, danger, and passion intertwine across every wild corner of nature.

name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
summary: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

name: There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension
summary: There is no game. So don't go messing things up by clicking everywhere. You don’t want to be kicked out of your video game world, do you? Of course not!

name: Dungeon Settlers
summary: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your expedition to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

name: VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator
summary: A tool that allows the VirZOOM bike controller to act like a normal gamepad for other games.

name: VOID SOAR
summary: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

name: ULTRA0
summary: An easy-to-play, fast-paced 3D shooter meets sci-fi yuri visual novel — a non-stop thrill ride from start to finish!

name: Crystal Caves HD
summary: Return to the underground classic world of treasures and traps in the HD remake of Crystal Caves! Guide Mylo through puzzles and arcade challenges of your favorite episodes, then explore the whole new Episode loaded with all new puzzles, enemies, challenges, hazards and help Mylo get back home!

name: Smoke & Lottery Simulator
summary: Manage your own tobacco shop and bar! Sell cigarettes and lottery tickets, serve drinks to your customers, manage your stocks, and grow your business in first-person. Can you juggle the counter and the shelves to build a thriving business?

name: Basketball Madness
summary: Basketball Madness is a super fun VR sports and arcade game. Play and fight against the enemies that want to distract you from scoring. Basketball shooting has never been so hilarious and so challenging at the same time.

name: Cloak and Dasher
summary: Become a lightning fast thief in this fast-paced platformer about looting ancient ruins with speed and style!

name: Hero Siege
summary: Hero Siege is a fast paced Pixel Art ARPG featuring an expansive roster of unique classes, deep build experimentation, and a player driven economy.

name: Soulbound Roguelike
summary: As heir to the fallen Divine Beast Sect, restore your clan by exploring procedurally generated Jianghu realms, forging pacts with mythical beasts, and combining Martial Skills × Blessings × Enchantments to craft your ultimate combat style—experience intense, satisfying roguelite action!

name: SPARK IGNITES
summary: Spark Ignites - A pixel fantasy RPG where the Star God's Blessing grants one wish each century. Orphan Ash and Clover uncover its bloody truth during their pilgrimage. Holding a world-changing secret, will you steal divine power or defy the gods? Every choice writes a new ending.

name: Frantic Dimension
summary: Frantic Dimension is a retro twin-stick shooter inspired by the earliest twin-sticks, 'Space Dungeon' and 'Robotron 2084'. Never stop moving and shooting... or you'll die.

name: Domain Defense VR
summary: Domain Defense VR is a stand alone game that has been built from the ground up for virtual reality. This tabletop style tower defense game will have you defending each unique level against waves of enemies and bosses with an arsenal of towers and special abilities.

name: Falling As Lightning
summary: Plan and build a deck of cards to represent your government, then use the structure you created to mobilize the military and unite warring star systems under the guiding light of your political ideology.

name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
summary: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

name: Baby Shark™: Sing & Swim Party
summary: Swim across the wide ocean with the Shark Family to enjoy the Fin-tastic Festival. Choose from five customizable characters and play either in the runner or rhythmic game mode. Sing and swim to fin-omenal songs and get rewarded with tons of musical cards to add to your album.

name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
summary: SpeedRunners 2 is a high-speed multiplayer platformer where rival superheroes face off in breakneck races using parkour, grappling hooks, and game-changing power-ups. Fall behind, and a shrinking ring of fire eliminates you – until only one runner remains.

name: Lucky Shield
summary: Lucky Shield - a medieval beat 'em up in which the player is a living shield that absorb magic orbs to power up its attacks and recapture the continent from invaders and traitors.

name: Hyperboard Extreme
summary: Hyperboard Extreme combines PS2-era arcade style racing with cool girls, crazy powerups, and intense, speedy action! This is a free vertical slice as a complete proof-of-concept for the next generation of indie racers!

name: Magma Karta
summary: Magma Karta is a satisfying strategy card game with roguelite and gambling elements. The rules can switch at any turn, challenging you to adapt your builds and your playstyle.

name: Alien Shooter 2: Reloaded
summary: This is the unique alloy of arcade action and RPG elements which combines well-established world of classical games and unmatched dynamics of the first part.

name: Ninpō! ~Shinobi Journey~
summary: “ Ninpō! ~Shinobi Journey~ ” is a 3D action-adventure RPG. A horde of succubi from another world has invaded, throwing the human realm into chaos…! Join the seductive ninja Sana on her thrilling journey across a Japanese-style world ♥

name: Potato Simulato: Together Co-op
summary: A rage-inducing physics platformer where you control a potato through absurd obstacles. Fall, fail, scream… and try again.

name: Clue/Cluedo
summary: Experience a fresh take on the classic crime-solving board game. Step into new mysteries and use your skills of deduction to find out whodunit, with what weapon and where.

name: Cooking Companions
summary: Unravel the mystery in this cute psychological horror VN, set deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains. Will you wind up on the chopping block?

name: Moon River
summary: Moon River is a short RPG adventure with an emphasis on music and atmosphere. Perhaps some secrets too... Explore the remains of an quiet, empty world & find the river's end.

name: Escape from Playtime
summary: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

name: I Got Smoke
summary: Vapes have controlled the world! You will play as a traditional cigarette and overthrone the evil Vape emperor Ruyan. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill every vape you see, or be killed. I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down shooting game.

name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

name: Gas Giant Voyage
summary: In the 798th parallel universe, there exists a gaseous planet, code-named "Gas Giant Voyage", which is entirely gaseous without any land. It is composed of various elemental gases, including metal elements and dust floating in the air left by meteorites tearing through the atmosphere.

name: The Duck Pond
summary: The Duck Pond is a condensed and relaxing idle game, focused on creating a short handcrafted experience with an ending. Throw food to attract different types of duck, read about them in the duckopedia, and maybe you'll discover the epic giga duck!

name: Mercenary Brotherhood
summary: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

name: DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain
summary: Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.

name: Black Ice
creators: Nonadecimal Creative / Super Duper Garrett Cooper
summary: Hack greedy megacorps to help as many people as you can in a high-agility cyberpunk looter/shooter RPG. Explore neon cyberspace vistas and outmaneuver AIs to customize your hacker OS and weapon combos. Play solo or online co-op with up to 10 people!

name: Chaos Chain
summary: A dark cyberpunk RPG in a bleak dystopian future. Become a "freelancer" in the heart of Slade City, a sprawling urban nightmare of grimy asphalt and broken dreams where crime and disorder run rampant. - Stay Alert. Stay Armed. Stay Alive. Don't lose your humanity.

name: Fast Food Simulator
summary: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

name: Trophy Chaser
summary: Help the Hero to collect all the trophys to be the master of the achievements! Trophy Chaser is a Rêtro platformer game where you have to collect the trophys to get the achievements, are you able to collect them all? Prove it in the gamer way!

name: Sword & Banner
summary: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

name: Cursed Treasure 2
summary: Why be good when you can be... bad? Cursed Treasure 2 is an addictive tower-defense game that puts the power of darkness at your fingertips. Build towers of powerful orcs, demons, and undead, and master powerful spells, to protect your precious hoard from all manner of no-good do-gooders.

name: Dandelion Void
summary: Survive the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Explore solo or with your friends. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

name: Assault Spy
summary: Dash, evade, and smash your way to the truth as the corporate spy, Asaru; or the reckless CIA agent, Amelia! Uncover the dark secrets of the Negabot mega corporation as you save the company from a hostile takeover. Assault Spy is a stylish, fast paced, pure-action game with a dash of comedy.

name: Chess Ultra
summary: Introducing Chess Ultra; the most breathtaking chess game ever made. Experience stunning 4K visuals, seamless online multiplayer, Grandmaster approved AI and full VR compatibility.

name: Laura's secret diary
summary: Help Laura, a female merchant masquerading as a gentleman, pay off her debt and keep her desires in check in this quick-response stylel puzzle game!

name: Room No. 9
summary: It's up to you to decide how far you're willing to go in order to survive in this psychological thriller visual novel about two best friends trapped in an experiment. Can these two men survive their choices between physical and psychological harm long enough to earn freedom?

name: Cyberpunk Store Simulator
summary: Run your own futuristic cyber-store in Cyberpunk Universe! Manufacture unique goods with a 3D printer, stock your shelves, set prices, and process cash or chip payments. Hire robotic staff, launch drone deliveries across the neon-lit city, and expand your shop into a massive retail empire.

name: Tether: ROLL, JUMP, SWING, GLIDE!
summary: With the Tether Tech Roller™ you can Roll, Jump, Swing and Glide seamlessly at great speeds without any injury! Earn more for a higher score in the Delivery Mode. Get your Tether Tech Roller™ today! Despite some users reporting injury we can assure you that the chances of that occurring are low.

name: Set Sail
summary: Set Sail is a western visual novel set in the modern day where the Golden Age of Pirating never properly ended. You get to meet characters interested in the world of piracy and choose how your days on the main land go.

name: The Last Trophy
summary: A space explorer receives a strange signal from an unknown planet. What is in this place? Help Mell discover the mysteries of this new land in this retro platformer with an arcade feel.

name: Synthwave Driver
summary: A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.

name: Silver Bullet
summary: Silver Bullet is a gothic arcade shooter: blast your way through spooky stages and macabre mini games as Van Helsing, to rescue your pet puppies who were dognapped by Reggie the Vampire!

name: Goob Wants an Android Girlfriend
summary: A cute puzzle game about fixing up android girls! Grow your collection of girlfriends and follow an adorably silly story while proving your wits along the way!

name: Magical Girl ER
summary: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

name: Diamond Mirage
summary: Follow Ellyn, a young elf kidnapped from home to be trained as a slave. The nightmare begins. Can he escape the oppression or will he succumb to the world of pleasure?

name: Zombie Shooter
summary: The human race is in danger again. This time scientists could not cope the imminent threat and became monsters themselves. Crowds of zombie people filled the secret research base. The dreadful contagion is about to spread earth wide. Use the last chance to save the humanity from total annihilation!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
summary: Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film. Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

name: MineMogul
summary: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

name: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
summary: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox is an immersive game that stands out for its realistic ragdoll physics, which together with various creation and damage tools, provides the player with a mix of realism and fun.

name: Water Delivery
summary: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

name: GARBAGE COUNTRY
summary: Garbage Country is a post-apocalyptic exploration sim from the creator of Cloud Gardens and Kingdom: New Lands. Drive across a handcrafted wasteland. Repel waves of enemy bots in tense tower-defense battles. Upgrade your car to travel further into the forgotten world buried under the dust.

name: Pilot Brothers
summary: The case of the stolen elephant! Elephant... Rare... Striped. ...has been kept for many years by an animal trader named Karbophos. Being unable to overcome abuse, it escaped and found a home at the zoo in our city. This is definitely Karbophos's work. To the zoo!

name: Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots
summary: A comedy sci-fi point & click adventure game made in the style of the early 90s classics.

name: Evitania Online - Idle RPG
summary: Online Idle RPG with an open world without the grind of classic MMORPGs. Collect rare loot, develop your character, master professions, craft powerful gear, and defeat challenging bosses as you progress endlessly.

name: 1 Screen Platformer
summary: This is a SHORT, 2D PLATFORMER with TIGHT CONTROLS about exploring a single level to get past a bunch of TRAPS. There is an EASY mode and a HARD mode depending on your skill level.

name: Love Delivery
summary: A coming-of-age romance simulation that follows the raw, relatable journey of a real loser.

name: Sword & Soil
summary: Farm, fish, fight and explore, and turn all of it into better gear. Sell your harvest, your catch and what monsters drop, then buy the armor the next road demands. Real-time combat: read the wind-up, step off the red tiles, strike back. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns to reach.

name: Cozy Country
summary: Escape into Cozy Country, a peaceful fantasy landscape creator. Paint forests, place rivers, build a village, add animals, then step inside your world and explore everything you've created. ❤️

name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
summary: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

name: The Drifting Crown
summary: A Victorian-era steampunk, action adventure game with roguelike elements where death is inevitable, monsters get nastier every run, and your noble quest to reopen the only pub left standing. Build your way to success, upgrade your skill tree to become more powerful, dispatch your enemies in style!

name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
summary: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM! Take on challenging mountain roads, visit Japanese legendary drifting spots in licensed JDM cars and immerse in the story about second chances told through manga pages. Explore an open world where every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

name: Urban Jungle
summary: Use luscious plants to turn your ordinary home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your small apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet your cat!

name: Lover's Trophy
summary: A Horror Dating Sim, Lover's trophy throws you into the arena with two love interests using you for their own personal amusement. With a completely customizable main character, go on a terrifying journey into the psyce of these two very dangerous men, and have the ride of a life time.

name: Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation
summary: Captain Wayne is an intense, fast-action Retro Shooter about a sailor with a SHOTGUN for an ARM!! With a cartoony, hand-drawn art style and gory gameplay, you'll have to mow down enemies through 8 action-packed locales to take back what's yours. ARE YOU READY TO RAISE ANCHOR?

name: Sunken Engine
summary: Sunken Engine Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulation. Restore your father’s old shipyard. Each arriving ship carries a dark mystery to be solved. Keep your customers satisfied while dealing with the strange and eerie happenings on the island.

name: Delivery Hot
summary: In this delivery-themed, 2D pixel action adventure, you play as a delivery man doing food runs and completing extra missions. Meet women and enjoy some "benefits" that make this a man's dream job!

name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
summary: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

name: Train Valley 2
creators: Alexey Davydov / Sergey Dvoynikov / Timofey Shargorodskiy / Flazm
summary: Build bigger and more complex railway networks than ever before! Building on the success of the original, you’ll get more of what you loved about the original and then some. With increasingly difficult and complex challenges from local industries, the Valley has never felt so vast! ALL ABOARD!

name: Book of Yog Idle RPG
summary: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

name: Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano
summary: In this moving and whimsical adventure game, explore Asfalia, a magical world threatened by a volcano. Join Charlie as you meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! A captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

name: Titan Chaser
summary: Titan Chaser is a surreal driving and walking experience, meant to evoke a feeling of being lost and discovering something mystical at your own pace instead of structured gameplay mechanics. Your job here is to scout giant creatures and scare them away without fighting or killing.

name: DSS 2: War Industry
summary: In this real-time grand strategy game, command armies, build cities, and manage a dynamic economy. Establish automated supply routes within your territory to streamline production. Fortify your defenses and brace for intense battles. Can you lead your empire to dominance?

name: Puzzle Spy International
summary: Pursue diamond thieves and a trail of cryptic puzzles in this short ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Deduce the puzzle rules, decode cryptograms and decipher clues as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!

name: HeroQuest: Digital Edition
summary: Descend into the dungeon to destroy the forces of Dread and protect the Realm in this tactical turn-based RPG based on the timeless tabletop legacy. Form a fellowship of four or set forth on your adventure solo, roll the dice and let the quest begin!

name: RetroSpace
summary: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

name: A Few Quick Matches
summary: A FEW QUICK MATCHES is a fast-paced, 1-4 player platform fighter that lets you bring old-school stick battles to life! play with your friends locally, or challenge players online in this flash-inspired spectacle!

name: GUITAR WORKSHOP
summary: Guitar Workshop is a hyper-realistic luthier simulation. Restore, customize, and refine instruments with screw-by-screw mechanics. Expand your workshop, master specialized workstations, and build your legendary guitar collection in your journey to become a master craftsman.

name: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
summary: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

name: Deadly Metropolis
summary: Deadly Metropolis is an intense, fast paced beat 'em up that takes the genre to brutal new heights. The deadliest era is here, a battle rages in the depths of Neo Babylos! Are you ready?!

name: DEADLINE DELIVERY
summary: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck through a difficult race against the clock.

name: Stealth Labyrinth
summary: Stealth Labyrinth is a first-person shooter game based on stealth mechanics. In a sci-fi labyrinth, the player must proceed, room after room, finding the right way until the end, before the time is out and everything explodes and avoiding all guard robot.

name: Tap Ninja - Idle game
summary: Defeat enemies, earn gold, upgrade your village, become a Ninja Master!

name: Titan Souls
summary: Between our world and the world beyond lie the Titan Souls, the spiritual source of all living things. Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.

name: Flame Keeper
summary: Flame Keeper is a dynamic, action rogue-lite that sees you restore the Eternal Flame, stolen by creatures of shadow. Fight through a rogue's gallery of monsters in diverse biomes using fiery combat skills. No sweat for a lump of coal like you.

name: The Crimson Diamond
summary: Follow amateur geologist and reluctant detective Nancy Maple to the ghost town of Crimson, Ontario to investigate the discovery of a massive diamond in this retro-inspired, EGA text parser mystery adventure!

name: Emergency Crew Volcano Eruption
summary: Emergency Crew - an exciting strategy of selfless heroes in the time of a disaster! Embark on a heroic rescue mission! Remember - time is valuable! Save people from disaster!

name: Hospital 666
summary: Hospital 666 is a 1-4 player horror escape game. Traverse through eerie hospital levels while observing the occurrence of anomalies and choosing the correct elevator. Some abnormal bosses will chase you to death, and you must find the right way to escape them.

name: Temple Of Snek
summary: A snaky tile-based puzzle dungeon adventure. Defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?

name: Toey Weedz Smoke One
summary: An funny early 3D retro inspired FPS. Become Mr. Weedz himself and fight on the power of Evil. Pass through 6 unique level and upgrade a Toey with gunz and skillz to put an end to the madness once and for all!

name: Prizefighters 2
summary: A retro inspired boxing game with customizable leagues and multiple career modes. Climb ranks as an amateur to become the Greatest, sign fighters and manage your own gym, or be the promoter and run your own tournaments.

name: Zombie Gunship Survival
summary: The Apocalypse came and went. All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of zombies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds.

name: OpenGloves
summary: OpenGloves is an open source, OpenVR Driver that allows for use of DIY Virtual Reality Hardware in SteamVR games.

name: The Cursed Amulet
summary: Enter a mysterious cave and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. Explore the depths of the cave, search for clues, and solve challenging puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

name: Mistwinter Bay
summary: Rule a town in this story heavy, visual novel-like fantasy RPG! Interact with townsfolk and foreign leaders, build and expand, and tackle randomized events that affect the town and its people.

name: Rocket Rats
summary: Rocket Rats is a survivors-like game where you defeat cheese-based astral bodies in space – as a rat! Clear waves of enemies, collect cheese, upgrade your gear, and conquer the moon!

name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
summary: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

name: Fast Cubes
summary: Fast Cubes is a puzzle game with time limits. Your objective is to place the cubes in their respective slots. Pass through portals, avoid spikes and find keys to achieve your objective. You'll need to think and to act to win this game.

name: Wild Ice
summary: Build brutal trap combos and fight alongside your defenses against hordes of Frosties with slapshots and bone-crushing body checks. Between battles explore a handcrafted open world, take on quests, discover upgrades and restore heat to a frozen world in this action-packed tower defense adventure.

name: Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator
summary: Run your own restaurant. Create your menu, hire staff, decorate the place, take orders, serve guests, and grow your business. Food critics, online orders, events, and kitchen chaos are on the menu!

name: Cyborg Mechanic
summary: Become a cyborg surgeon mechanic in shady and absurd cyberpunk underworld. Diagnose your clients, cut off limbs and remove organs, upgrade bodies and brains. Attach fancy augmentations during complex procedures. Fight for fame, but beware of police forces always on the lookout for the ones like you.

name: The Starlight Amulet
summary: Explore a mysterious island in this beautiful hand-drawn side-scrolling adventure. Befriend the characters you meet in order to learn new abilities that let you reach new areas. Story, visuals, game design and music by FreddeGredde.

name: Crappy Driver
summary: Crappy Driver is a physics-based vehicle builder where you deliver passengers and packages, hoping you don’t lose them along the way. Build from weird parts, drive to the next stop without falling apart and make your vehicle stranger with every ride.

name: Dead State: Reanimated
summary: Dead State is a narrative-driven survival RPG set at the dawn of the undead apocalypse. Drawing inspiration from classic RPGs like Fallout, X-Com, and Suikoden, Dead State combines strategic, turn-based combat with base building mechanics, character creation, and social management.

name: Hector: Badge of Carnage - Full Series
summary: All 3 episodes available now - get the full season!

name: Door Kickers 2: Task Force North
summary: Command military Special Ops Teams in gripping tactical combat against a Middle East-based terrorist network. Sequel to RockPaperShotgun's "Best Tactics Game of 2014".

name: Wagotabi: A Japanese Journey
summary: Wagotabi is an educational RPG teaching Japanese from the ground up. Immerse yourself in the language through interactive dialogues, quest-solving, and puzzles, all while exploring Japan and its rich culture. Will you become a Japanese master?

name: Kotel Ne Gori: A Friend of Lena Boots
summary: Become Kotel and liberate beloved Princess of Gigacrush that was abducted. Accept true-hearted friends to accompany your traverse.

name: Incursion Red River
summary: IRR is a tactical PvE Co-Op extract shooter set in a de-stabilized and immersive modern-day Vietnam. As a PMC for a mysterious organization, deal with 3 factions that stand to gain from the chaos. Engage in ruthless combat, plan your deployment, and explore the world as your journey unfolds.

name: Crystal Clash
summary: Crystal Clash is a mix of Lane Battles and Deckbuilding - with action-packed tug-of-war strategy, just like your favorite RTS mods from back in the day! :) Play 2v2 or co-op with a friend, or pair up with new allies and enemies! Collect cards, build your decks and have fun crushing your enemies!

name: Song in the Smoke
summary: Using the power of virtual reality, Song in the Smoke puts your survival directly in your own hands. Enter this dangerous world outside of time, where you must craft weapons, make clothes, build fires, and brew healing elixirs to steel yourself against its vicious predators.

name: Crafting Town
summary: Crafting Town Is : A Crafting game with Simulation&Building where you can Craft and Develop your Village, Source Management and Quests.

name: Arrow Tourney
summary: Match2. Step by step you'll have to start thinking to win against your lovely opponents, that will keep distracting you more with less and less cloth on them.

name: Gold Mining Simulator
summary: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

name: Karryn's Prison
summary: Control the confident, sexy Karryn as she becomes the new Chief Warden in the notorious all-male prison in this RPG. Go manage the prison and its inmates, but can you also manage Karryn's ever rising desires? Experience the true adult game that fully marries adult elements into all gameplay!

name: Business Simulator 2026
summary: In Business Simulator 2026, you start with a small capital and aim to build a business empire in the city by deciding which business to start in which shop and deciding the prices. Business Simulator 2026 is a business simulation that will test your business acumen and strategic planning skills.

name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
summary: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

name: Football Story
summary: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

name: Bone Appetit
summary: When the king declares that all food is now his, whatcha' gonna' do? Raise a skeleton slave to steal it back for you, of course!

name: Dark Jungle
summary: Dark Jungle is a 2d fantasy adventure where you play as the great magician Dorian and find yourself in a fairytale forest.

name: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
summary: A retro spy FPS inspired by the N64 era. Go guns-blazing in action-packed shootouts, steal secret plans, and accomplish objectives while foiling evildoers’ schemes as a secret agent in a solo or co-op campaign. Fight friends in both local split-screen multiplayer and online with up to 8 opponents.

name: Steel Division 2
summary: Steel Division 2 is a historically-accurate WW2 real-time strategy game set on the Eastern Front. Features 1:1-scale turn-based army management and real-time tactical battles with thousands of men at your order.

name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
summary: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

name: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
summary: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

name: Quick Quest
summary: In Fantasy world, evil knights are threatening the equilibrium, Only you can fight them to restore the peace and the good balance of things.
